docs.title: Accessory Support
docs.text:
The following content will only be compatible with FSang18's Heros v12.0.0+

Here, you can find step by step instructions for creating a custom addon to my addon specifically for adding in accessories for custom skins on the following powers which have accessory support. Download the Test Pack then click on which of the available powers you'd like to add a custom accessory for:

  • Metal Mimicry
  • Cryokinesis

docs.title: Instructions:
docs.text:
• Download the More Skins Test Pack below:
    • More Fsang Skins Test Pack.zip
  • Unzip the folder and navigate to addon\more_fsang_skins\accessories\
    • Here you will see two files named "colossus_test.json" and "colossus2_test.json" with each being for the Metal and Diamond forms, respectively
      • Change the "test" part of the names to whatever unique identifier you want your skin to use (Make sure to remember the exact name you use instead of "test")
  • Now, navigate to assets\fsang\textures\models\dynamic_textures\
    • Here, you will see two folders, one named "colossus" and one named "colossus2" each folder contains the base texture for the Metal and Diamond forms, respectively. Additionally, the Blockbench color paletts can be downloaded below:
    • colossus_palette.gpl
    • colossus2_palette.gpl
    • cryokinesis_palette.gpl
  • Once your custom skin is made, save it in the correct folder(s) using the same identifier from the accessory menu setup.
  • Now, we can navigate to: assets\fsang\lang\ where you should find a file named "en_us"
    • In this file, you will be designating a name for your accessory slot in-game. Change the "test" portion in this to whatever your identifier was from before, then assign your accessory a name.
  • Once you have done all of this, navigate back to your "more_fsang_skins-1.0.0" folder. here you will be selecting everything you see, and zipping it all together.
    • Once Zipped, you will change the .zip file extension to a .jar
  • If you have done everything correctly, then when you drag / drop that .jar file into your mods folder, you should see your new skin / accessory menu when you equip the compatible powers

docs.title: Commands List
docs.text:
Below is a list of all relevant commands for the addonpack.

Note, not all of these commands are accessible without cheats enabled / Operator rights.

docs.title: Superpower Commands:
docs.text:
/superpower add fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to add powers to any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower query @

  • This command can be used to list any / all powers a player has. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower remove fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to remove powers from any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower replace fsang:powername fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to replace powers from any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/superpower set fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to set powers from any player, erasing all others. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

/ability unlock @s fsang:power_name all

  • This command can unlock every ability for the power you have, just replace the power_name with the name of the power you have.

/ability lock @s fsang:power_name all

  • This command can lock every ability for the power you have, just replace the power_name with the name of the power you have.

docs.title: FSang Skill Point Commands
docs.text:
/FSang.EXP set @s #

  • This command sets your Exp to whatever you replace # with.

/FSang.Level set @s #

  • This command sets your Level to whatever you replace # with. Max level 50.

/FSang.SkillPoints set @s #

  • This command sets your Skill Points to whatever you replace # with.

docs.title: FSang Gamerule Commands
docs.text:
/gamerule FsangItemCooldown true

  • Enables the cooldown timer to swap powers (not including symbiotes)

/gamerule FsangItemCooldown

  • Disables the cooldown timer to swap powers (not including symbiotes)

/gamerule FsangSymbiote Cooldown true

  • Enables the cooldown timer to swap symbiotes

/gamerule FsangSymbiote Cooldown false

  • Disables the cooldown timer to swap symbiotes

/gamerule FsangStrongPunch false

  • Disables the Strong Punch shockwave effect.

/gamerule FsangStrongPunchDamage #

  • This command sets your Strong Punch Shockwave to kick in whatever you replace the # with it.

docs.title: Age-based Powers
docs.text:
/FSang.Age set #

  • This command can work with any power that uses an Age-based system to set their age to whatever you replace # with.

docs.title: Bone Claws:
docs.text:
/scoreboard players set @s X_Gene 20

  • This command sets your Bone Claws to Logan's

/scoreboard players set @s X_Gene 21

  • This command sets your Bone Claws to Laura's

/scoreboard players set @s X_Gene 22

  • This command sets your Bone Claws to Dakkon's

docs.title: Electrokinesis:
docs.text:
/scoreboard players set @s FSang.Electrokinesis.Color 1

  • This command sets your Electrokinesis Mutation color to Blue

/scoreboard players set @s FSang.Electrokinesis.Color 2

  • This command sets your Electrokinesis Mutation color to Gold

/scoreboard players set @s FSang.Electrokinesis.Color 3

  • This command sets your Electrokinesis Mutation color to Purple

docs.title: Karma:
docs.text:
/FSang.Karma set @s #

  • This command can be used set your Karma Levels to whatever you replace the # with.

docs.title: Teleportation:
docs.text:
/scoreboard players set @s X_Gene 1

  • This command sets your Teleportation Mutation color to Blue

/scoreboard players set @s X_Gene 90

  • This command sets your Teleportation Mutation color to Red

docs.title: Secondary Powers:
docs.text:
/FSang.Secondary add <power> #

  • This command allows you to add as many tokens to the secondary power designated within the <power> section based on the number placed in the # section.

/FSang.Secondary remove <power> #

  • This command allows you to remove as many tokens to the secondary power designated within the <power> section based on the number placed in the # section.

/scoreboard players set @ Fsang.Age.Symbiote #

  • This command sets your Natural Symbiote Codex Bond to whatever you replace # with.

docs.title: Speedforce (Not Tachyon):
docs.text:
/Fsang.SpeedTrail get (primary / sescondary)

  • This command gets either your primary or secondary Speedforce Trail hex color depending on which you use (primary or secondary)

/Fsang.SpeedTrail set (primary / sescondary) (hex)

  • This command sets either your primary or secondary Speedforce Trail hex color depending on which you use (primary or secondary) based on the hex color code you enter at the end.

docs.title: FAQs
docs.text: Here are some Frequently asked Questions, and their answers:

docs.title: Q. What are the commands for...?
docs.text: A. All of the relevant commands for this addon can be found on the Commands page here on the wiki.

docs.title: Q. Where can I find Vibranium or Titanium
docs.text: A. They can spawn under Heart-Shaped herbs which can spawn anywhere in the overworld that has dirt. You can also find titanium in the Symbiote meteors.

docs.title: Q. Where can I find Uru Ore?
docs.text: A. Uru Ore can be found in Mjolnir Crashsite's.

docs.title: Q. How can I charge RF?
docs.text: A. You can use RF Charger in the base mod or use various different mods. Some examples are: Create: Crafts & Additions, Powah, Mekanism, Mekanism generators.

docs.title: Q. What is the strongest / best power / Iron Man Suit / Power Variant?
docs.text: A. There’s not one “best” there are pros and cons for every power. In terms of base raw damage output, Worldbreaker Hulk has the most base damage.

docs.title: Q. How can i gain Skill Points Experience?
docs.text: A. You gain them overtime, killing mobs, using abilities. You can find more detailed information in the Skill Point System Page.

docs.title: Q. How do I access the Official Server?
docs.text: A. You can join our Discord server and find the information about Official Server.

docs.title: Q. "I can't see the crafting recipe of x Iron Man Armor?"
docs.text: A. Iron Man Suit's are unlocked upon progress. You need to start crafting them from Model 1 up to which suit you want. The recipe unlocks are tied to advancements, you can see your progress there. You can cheat in your way by giving yourself Iron Man advancements.

docs.title: Q. How do I remove my powers?
docs.text: A. Using an empty syringe (or corresponding item) while having an empty offhand can remove your power.

docs.title: Q. When will the next update be out?
docs.text: A. When it’s ready. I don’t keep exact timeframes on when something will be released. If it’s in my current work queue in the planned content channel on my Discord that means it will be in the next released update. If it’s not, it won’t be. Aside from that, nothing from my personal To-Do list will take priority above something that’s commissioned

docs.title: Q. How do I get Symbiote powers?
docs.text: A. You’ll need to craft an “Artificial Symbiote” and right click it. Doing so will randomly assign you a Symbiote to transform into. To get a "Natural Symbiote", you’ll need to find a Symbiote meteor and kill the Symbiote that spawns.

docs.title: Q. How do I remove a Symbiote?
docs.text: A. If you craft a “Symbiote Container” and right click it, you can store whatever Symbiote you currently have in the container. Right clicking a filled container will re-implant the Symbiote in you.

docs.title: Q. How do I get rid of the Syringe / Container cooldown?
docs.text: A. As of version 9.0.0 there is a config for item cooldowns and symbiote cooldowns. Alternatively you can use the command: "/FSang.gamerule item/symbiote true/false" to disable the cooldown, however on launch, your game will always default to whatever your config is set to.

docs.title: Q. How do I use an AI Chip?
docs.text: A. You need to insert them on helmets / Nano Suits / Hulkbuster. Detailed info on AI Chips Page.

docs.title: Q. How do I get Human DNA?
docs.text: A. With an empty offhand, crouch and right click an empty syringe.

docs.title: Q. Can I keep / increase my age as a Viltrumite or as a Asgardian with commands?
docs.text:
A. You can not keep your age on death, theres no config for that.

B. "/FSang.Age set #" This command can work with any power that uses an Age-based system to set their age to whatever you replace # with.

docs.title: Karma
docs.text: Karma can be gained or lost via killing mobs in your world. It can be raised or lowered nearly infinitely. The specific mob you kill is tied to a specific value as listed below:

docs.title: Passive Mobs
docs.text:
Killing the following passive mobs will grant -1 Karma when killed:

minecraft:cow minecraft:sheep minecraft:pig minecraft:chicken minecraft:rabbit minecraft:horse minecraft:donkey minecraft:mule minecraft:camel minecraft:cat minecraft:fox minecraft:parrot minecraft:frog minecraft:goat minecraft:axolotl minecraft:sniffer minecraft:squid minecraft:glow_squid minecraft:cod minecraft:salmon minecraft:bee minecraft:dolphin minecraft:wolf minecraft:mooshroom minecraft:llama minecraft:turtle minecraft:bat minecraft:tropical_fish

docs.title: Positive Mobs
docs.text:
Killing the following positive mobs will remove the corresponding Karma when killed:

minecraft:villager -50 minecraft:iron_golem -50 minecraft:wandering_trader -50 minecraft:player -100

docs.title: Hostile Mobs
docs.text:
Killing the following hostile mobs will remove the corresponding Karma when killed:

minecraft:zombie +1 minecraft:creeper +2 minecraft:vex +3 minecraft:husk +1 minecraft:enderman +2 minecraft:ravager +8 minecraft:drowned +1 minecraft:phantom +2 minecraft:vindicator +3 minecraft:skeleton +1 minecraft:pillager +2 minecraft:evoker +6 minecraft:stray +1 minecraft:witch +3 minecraft:magma_cube +2 minecraft:spider +1 minecraft:guardian +3 minecraft:piglin +1 minecraft:cave_spider +1 minecraft:blaze +3 minecraft:hoglin +3 minecraft:slime +1 minecraft:wither_skeleton +4 minecraft:zoglin +3 minecraft:endermite +1 minecraft:ghast +4 minecraft:zombified_piglin +1 minecraft:silverfish +1 minecraft:shulker +4 minecraft:piglin_brute +6 minecraft:elder_guardian +8 minecraft:warden +10 minecraft:wither +20 minecraft:ender_dragon +100

Currently (as of v12.4.1), Karma only corresponds with being able to weild the following tertiary powers, Bonus Stats and damage on specific powers:

  • Mjolnir
  • Stormbreaker
  • Hellspawn
  • Spirit of Vengance

If you have cheats on you can use /Fsang.Karma command to change your Karma.

docs.title: Skill Point System
docs.text:
Skill Points System are how you upgrade your powers in the power menu. You gain Skill Points via;

  • Gain SP Xp on kills, gaining xp on kills are target's Max Health/10 EXP
  • Buying 1 Skill Point with 60 Minecraft Level
  • Get 1 Skill Point by using Skill Catalyst
  • Gain 2 SP Xp by using your abilities, 10 uses for each ability after 5 minute cooldown per ability
  • Gain 1 SP Xp every 2 minute passively

Related Information

  • The Skill Points and Levels are not transferred between power. Every power starts with Level 1 and 1 Skill Point
  • Max Level for a power is 50. You can't gain more Skill Points via Level System once you reached max level except for buying them with vanilla levels or via catalyst.
  • Buying Skill Points with Vanilla Levels does not change your Level.
  • Getting Skill Points with Skill Catalyst does not change your Level.
  • Skill Catalysts are a potion that can be crafted used any filled power syringe. You brew them with 1 Filled Power Syringe and Regeneration inside of Brewing Stand .You must have the effect for at least 1 full minute to gain the Free Skill Point. After using this, there will be a 5 minute cooldown before you can use another one. Current ways to get Skill Catalyst effects are;
    • Potion of Skill Catalyst
    • Splash Potion of Skill Catalyst
    • Lingering Potion of Skill Catalyst

    • Arrow of Skill Catalyst

      * Filled Power Syringes are obtained with right clicking a empty syringe while having any Main Power. You are sacrificing a Power for Skill Points.

docs.title: RF Charger
docs.text:
The RF Charger can be obtained via crafting using the following recipe:

  • After placing this block down, you must hold your fuel source in your mainhand (Coal or Charcoal), then you must hold the item you wish to charge in your offhand. One you've done this, right-click the block to use 1 fuel to gain +100 RF in the held item.
  • This item will not charge more than 100 RF at a time.
  • This is a block designed to be used by anyone who does not wish to download / install any other RF charging mod.

docs.title: Runic Block
docs.text:
The Runic Block can be obtained via “combining a crafting table, an ender pearl, a stone block and a glass bottle in a crafting grid”.

Uses: - This block can be used to give an unemployed villager the Wizard job.

Related Information: - This block requires a pickaxe of any level to be mined, and cannot be mined via an empty hand.

docs.title: Scientific Table
docs.text:
The Scientific Table can be obtained via “placing a crafting table, a glass bottle, a book and quill and a piece of paper into a crafting grid”.

Uses: * This block can be used to give an unemployed villager the Mad Scientist job.

Related Information: * This block can use an axe of any level to be mined quicker, but can also be mined via an empty hand.

docs.text:

docs.title: Adamantium
docs.text:
The "Adamantium" can be found via placing two iron with one Vibranium in the crafting table and requires a "Diamond Pickaxe or higher" to mine.

Uses:

  • This ingot can be to enhance the Bone Claws mutation.
    • This ingot can be used to craft Vibranium Shield and Adamantium Circuit.

Crafting Uses:

  • Using ingots of this ore, various tools can be crafting using similar recipes to vanilla tools.

docs.title: Kryptonite
docs.text:
The "Kryptonite Block" can be found in "Kryptonite Meteors" in the overworld and requires a "Iron Pickaxe or higher to mine".

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will drop 4 Kryptonite Shard.
  • This block, and any variation of it's craftable versions can be used to weaken / inhibit any of the Kryptonian or Half Kryptonian variants
  • When right click a Kryptonite Block with a Kryptonite Shard(in the overworld) it can grow more kryptonite shards overtime very slowly.
  • When holding or containing this block or any form of kryptonite(except for Batman(Kryptonite)Suit and Batman(Kryptonite) Utility Belt) will give you a Kryptonite Exposure Rate and when it reaches max you will get the wither 3 effect for 10 sec until you get rid of the kryptonite.

Crafting Uses:

  • This ore can be broken down and used to craft various tools via similar recipes to the Vanilla Minecraft tools

docs.title: Mysterium
docs.text:
The "Mysterium" can be created via putting a blackstone on top of lava cauldron and click the blackstone with a Cosmic Particle, requires a "Diamond Pickaxe or higher to mine".

Step 1:

Step 2:

Step 3:

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will grant 1 piece of Raw Mysterium. This ore is affected by Fortune.

Crafting Uses:

  • This ore can be used to craft Model LXXII.
  • This ore has Anti Magic properties.

docs.title: Nth Metal
docs.text:
The "Nth Metal" can be found only in "Nth Meteor" and requires a "Wooden Pickaxe or higher to mine".

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will grant 1 piece of Raw Nth. This ore is affected by Fortune.

Crafting Uses:

  • Using the blocks / ingots, various Atlantean armors, Amazon weapons, Neptune's Trident etc can be crafted.
  • Using the Nth templates Neptune's Trident can be upgraded in the power menu.
  • Use this ore and the Martian Fossil to craft a Green Martian DNA.

docs.title: Techno Organic Ingot
docs.text:
The Techno-Organic Ingot can be obtained via placing x2 Augmented Human DNA, x1 Iron Ingot and x1 Copper Ingot into a crafting table”.

Uses:

  • These ingots can be crafted into a block and used to further enhance the Winged Flight and En Sabah Nur mutations to the their upgraded versions.
  • This ingot can also be broken down an used to craft various tools.
  • This ingot can be used at making the Artificial Necrotech.

Related Information:

  • After crafted the ingot you will get back the syringes.

docs.title: Titanium
docs.text:
The "Titanium" can be found via "the Palladium Meteor which is found very deep below a Heart-Shaped Herb, or via one of the Symbiote Meteors from the FSang18 Heroes Addon rarely in any Plains Biome" and requires a "Diamond pickaxe or higher to mine".

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will drop 1 piece of raw titanium. This ore is affected by fortune.

Crafting Uses:

  • Breaking down this ore can be used to craft various things such as: Iron Man suit bases, Symbiote Containers, Gold-Titanium Alloy, etc.

docs.title: Uru
docs.text:
The "Uru" can be found only in "Mjolnir Crashsite" and requires a "Diamond Pickaxe or higher to mine".

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will grant 1 piece of Raw Uru. This ore is affected by Fortune.

Crafting Uses:

  • Using the blocks / ingots, various Asgardian armors, Iron Man suits and Hofund can be crafted.
  • Using the Uru templates Mjolnirs / Stormbreaker / Hofund can be upgraded in the power menu.
  • Use this ore the make Idunn Apple which will grant you one of the Asgardian Powers.

docs.title: Vibranium
docs.text:
The "Vibranium" can be found via the Palladium Meteor which is found very deep below a Heart-Shaped Herb and requires a "Diamond pickaxe or higher to mine".

Uses:

  • Mining this ore will drop 1 piece of raw vibranium. This ore is affected by fortune.

Related Information:

  • Vibranium Ingots can be used to craft Adamantium Ingots, Vibranium Shields, Vibranium Circuits, Vibranium Flux-Capacitors, and the Nano-Housing Unit

docs.title: Assorted Chemicals
docs.text:
The "Assorted Chemicals" can be obtained by using 6x Glass Bottle, 2x Dark Matter Sample and 1x Augmented Human DNA in a crafting table;

Uses:

  • Consuming this item and getting strike by lightning will grant you one of the Speedforce variants.

Related Information:

  • Getting which Speedster after consuming this is random chance.

docs.title: Compound V
docs.text:
The "Compound V" can be obtained by using 1x Assorted Chemicals, 1x X-Gene, 1x Super Soldier Serum and 1x Galactic Cluster Sample in a crafting table:

Uses:

  • Consuming this item will grant you one of the Supes variant.

Related Information:

  • Getting which Supe variant after consuming this is random chance.

docs.title: Cosmic Particle
docs.text:
The Cosmic Particle can be obtained via rare chance in an End City Chest.

  • This item can be used to craft the Sentry power syringe and Cosmic Ingot.
  • This item has the same rarity as the most rare template found in End City chests

docs.title: Dark Matter Sample
docs.text:
The "Dark Matter Sample" can be obtained by using 1x Kryptonite Shard, 1x Lapis Lazuli, 1x Augmented Human DNA and 1x Eye of Ender in a crafting table:

Uses:

  • Consuming this item will grant you one of the Meta Human variants.

Related Information:

  • Currently only Meta Human in the addon is Geokinesis.

docs.title: Empty Syringe
docs.text:
Empty Syringes can be crafted by putting 3 iron ingots on top of 3 glass panes with one iron nugget below

Uses:

  • Empty Syringes can be used to remove and store any currently equipped power or DNA when right-clicking without crouching. To take your "Player's Human DNA," crouch and right-click.

docs.title: Galactic Cluster Sample
docs.text:
The Galactic Cluster Sample can be obtained via right-clicking an activated End Portal with an empty bottle.

  • Right-Clicking this item in the End dimension can cause the user and the nearest 3 other players within a 10 block radius to obtain a Cosmic Radiated power.
  • When used, the 4 afflicted players will need to wait for the 30 second long efffect to wear off before the Cosmic storm will strike
  • It can used to craft Compound V.

docs.title: Gamma Radiation
docs.text:
The "Gamma Radiation" can be obtained by using 1x Echo Shard, 1x X-Gene, 1x Eye of Ender, 1x Dragon's Breath and 1x Augmented Human DNA in a crafting table;

Uses:

  • Consuming this item and standing next to a explosion will grant you one of the Hulk variants.

Related Information:

  • Getting which Hulk variant after consuming this item is random chance.

docs.title: Idunn Apple
docs.text:
The "Idunn Apple" can be obtained by using 4x Uru Ingot, 4x Uru Block and 1x Golden Apple in a crafting table;

Uses:

  • Consuming this item will grant you one of the Asgardian variant.

Related Information:

  • Getting which Asgardian variant after consuming this item is random chance.

docs.title: Scourge Virus
docs.text:
The "Scourge Virus" can be obtained via brewing Potion of Weakness with a Viltrumite Fossil inside a Brewing Stand.

Uses:

  • When used on any Viltrumite variant it starts to rapidly drain their hunger (0.5 saturation point every second), after their saturation run out it starts to give them 5 Void Damage every second.
  • When used on Full Blooded Viltrumite variants it gives Slownes 4 and Weakness 4 effect in the duration of Scourge Virus effect.
  • When used on Viltrumite - Human Hybrid variant it gives Slownes and Weakness effect in the duration of Scourge Virus effect.
  • When used on Viltrumite - Thraxan Hybrid variant it only drains hunger and gives damage afterwards, no slowness and weakness, in the duration of Scourge Virus effect.

Related Information:

  • When under the effect as a Viltrumite you can not hold a Milk Bucket.
  • Scourge Virus has no effect on Non-Viltrumites.
  • Scourge Virus has 4 different variaton for giving the effect * Potion of Scourge Virus * Splash Potion of Scourge Virus * Lingering Potion of Scourge Virus * Arrow of Scourge Virus *

docs.title: Super Soldier Serum
docs.text:

docs.title: Symbiote Container

Uses:

docs.title: X-Gene
docs.text:
The "X-Gene" can be obtained by using 1x Ruby Quartz, 1x Lapis Lazuli, 1x Augmented Human DNA and 1x Eye of Ender in a crafting table:

Uses:

,

docs.title: Kree Fossil
docs.text:
The Kree Fossil can be obtained via a 40% chance when mining the Kree Skeleton which is found on a Fallen Kree Ship in the End dimension.

  • This fossil can be used to craft the Kree-Hybrid power.

docs.title: Kryptonian Fossil
docs.text:
The Kryptonian Fossil can be obtained via a 40% chance when mining the Kryptonian Skeleton which is found on a Fallen Kryptonian Ship in the End dimension.

docs.title: Martian Fossil

docs.title: Viltrumite Fossil

The Viltrumite Fossil can be obtained via a 40% chance when mining the Viltrumite Skeleton which is found on a Fallen Viltrumite Ship in the End dimension.

docs.title: Smoke Pellet

docs.title: Sound Gun
docs.text:
The Sound Gun can be obtained via crafting with x4 Iron Ingots, x2 Redstone Flux Crystals, x2 Iron Circuits, and x1 Note Block in a crafting table:

Uses:

docs.text:

docs.title: Flame
docs.text:
Flame Batarangs can be obtained via crafting with 1x Blaze Powder, 1x Iron Circuit, and x2 Batarangs (Normal) in a crafting table, yielding x4 Flame Batarangs.

Uses:

  • Flame Batarangs can be thrown set target on fire, and deals 5 damage.
  • Up to x32 of these can be stored in any Utility Belt.

docs.title: Frost
docs.text:
Frost Batarangs can be obtained via crafting with 1x Packed Ice, 1x Iron Circuit, and x2 Batarangs (Normal) in a crafting table, yielding x4 Frost Batarangs.

Uses:

docs.title: Kryptonite

docs.title: Shock

docs.title: Sonic

Uses:

docs.text:

docs.title: Prototype Web-Shooters
docs.text:
The Prototype Web-Shooters can be obtained via crafting by using 4x Iron Ingots, 1x Diamond Circuit, 3x Iron Circuits and 1x Bow as seen below:

Uses:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): Web Zip - Attach a web to a block within 30 blocks in the direction you are looking to be pulled towards it. This ability costs 2 WF when used (even if your target is out of range).
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Web Shot - Fire off a high velocity ball of webs which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit. This ability costs 5 WF and has a cooldown of 1/4 seconds.

Related Information:

  • These Web Shooters have a max Capacity of 1,000 WF (Web Fluid)
  • When wearing any chest piece, these web shooters will become hidden.
  • This gadget requires right-clicking on Web Cartridge while equipped to fill it.

docs.title: Upgraded Web-Shooters
docs.text:
The Upgraded Web-Shooters can be obtained via crafting by using 4x Iron Ingots, 3x Diamond Circuit, 1x Netherite Circuits and 1x Prototype Web-Shooter as seen below:

Uses:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): Web Zip - Attach a web to a block within 30 blocks in the direction you are looking to be pulled towards it. This ability costs 2 WF when used (even if your target is out of range).
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Web Shot - Fire off a high velocity ball of webs which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit. This ability costs 5 WF and has a cooldown of 1/4 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Impact Web Blast - Fire off a larger ball of webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and will trap them in a cobweb. This ability costs 20 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Concussion Web Blast - Fire off a ball of webs which can deal 1 damage when a target is hit, and hit with a Knockback of 3. This ability costs 15 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): Change Web-Type - Switch through all of your available web types in your 2nd Slot.

Related Information:

  • These Web Shooters have a max Capacity of 3,000 WF (Web Fluid)
  • When wearing any chest piece, these web shooters will become hidden.
  • This gadget requires right-clicking on Web Cartridge while equipped to fill it.

docs.title: Advanced Web-Shooters
docs.text:
The Advacned Web-Shooters can be obtained via crafting by using 4x Diamonds, 3x Netherite Circuit, 1x Titanium Circuits and 1x Upgraded Web-Shooter as seen below:

Uses:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): Web Zip - Attach a web to a block within 30 blocks in the direction you are looking to be pulled towards it. This ability costs 2 WF when used (even if your target is out of range).
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Web Shot - Fire off a high velocity ball of webs which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit. This ability costs 5 WF and has a cooldown of 1/4 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Impact Web Blast - Fire off a larger ball of webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and will trap them in a cobweb. This ability costs 20 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Concussion Web Blast - Fire off a ball of webs which can deal 1 damage when a target is hit, and hot with a Knockback of 3. This ability costs 15 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Shock Web Blast - Fire off a ball of webs enhanced by electricity which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit, and applies the Shock effect for 4 seconds on the target that is hit. This ability costs 25 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): Web Grenade - Fire off a large ball of condensed webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and creates a non-destructive explosion when hit. This ability costs 50 WF and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): Change Web-Type - Switch through all of your available web types in your 2nd Slot.

Related Information:

  • These Web Shooters have a max Capacity of 8,000 WF (Web Fluid)
  • When wearing any chest piece, these web shooters will become hidden.
  • This gadget requires right-clicking on Web Cartridge while equipped to fill it.

docs.title: AI Chips
docs.text:
AI Chips can be obtained via crafting with x1 Netherite Circuit, x4 Titanium Circuit, x1 Diamond and respective color of AI with a blueprint book inside a crafting table.

Uses:

  • When wearing any Iron Man-Type Helmet / Suit, Right-Click this item in your mainhand to equip it directly into your suit's Helmet.
  • If you already have a AI Chip inserted, you can either Right-Click a new one in your offhand to swapp them out, or Crouch + Right-Click the helmet in your offhand to remove the AI Chip currently installed.
    • Nano Suits: Right-Click to AI chip in your mainhand while nano suit equipped for inserting the Chip. For removing Crouch + Right-Click with a empty mainhand.
    • Hulkbusters: Right-Click to AI chip in your mainhand while nano suit equipped for inserting the Chip. For removing Crouch + Right-Click with a empty mainhand.
  • Equipping AI Chip will drain your Arc Reactor's RF energy at a slow rate. Using commands will increase the drain speed.
  • Theres currently 10 AI Chip available in the addon. They all function the same, only differences is varying lines and characters of AI's, which is purely cosmetic. Available AI Chips and their colors to craft are;
    • J.A.R.V.I.S. - White
    • E.D.I.T.H. - Light Blue
    • F.R.I.D.A.Y. - Pink
    • H.E.L.E.N. - Orange
    • K.A.R.E.N. - Cyan
    • K.A.T.I.E. - Gray
    • M.O.T.H.E.R.B.O.A.R.D. - Black
    • P.E.P.P.E.R. - Red
    • T.A.D.A.S.H.I. - Purple
    • T.O.N.Y. - Blue
    • V.E.R.O.N.I.C.A. - Green

How to use AI Commands:

  • To activate your AI, type it's name in the chat.
  • AI Systems - Highlight: Say "Tag All" in the chat to highlight all entities around you in a 30 block radius. saying "Tag Off" will disable it.
    • Saying "Tag Passive", "Tag Hostile" or "Tag Player" will only highlight the chosen entity-type.
  • AI Systems - Energy Readings: Say "Energy Check" in the chat to passively have your AI alert you to your Arc Reactor's energy levels. Saying "Stop Energy Check" will stop the passive checks. This does not drain any RF to have active.
  • AI Systems - Health Readings: Say "Health Check" in the chat to passively have your AI alert you to your health levels. Saying "Stop Health Check" will stop the passive checks. This does not drain any RF to have active.
  • AI Systems - Take Screenshot: Say "Clip That" in the chat to take a screenshot which will be saved in the designated "screenshots" folder in your minecraft folder.
  • AI Systems - Night Vision: Say "Night Vision On" in the chat to enable Night Vision Mode. Say "Night Vision Off" to disable the Night Vision Mode.
  • AI Systems - Target HUD: Say "Target HUD On" in the chat to enable the HUD for scanning targets.
    • Say "Target HUD Scan" while looking at a target to store their name and current Health on your HUD. Say "Target HUD Off" to disable the HUD.
  • AI Systems - Read: Say "Read" in the chat to have the link to that blueprint's suit sent to you by your AI.
  • AI System - Help: Say "Cheat Sheet On" in the chat to have all the available AI commands displayed on your HUD. Say "Cheat Sheet Off" to disable the HUD.

docs.title: Arc Reactors
docs.text:
Here, you will be able to find all the difference Arc Reactors available, and any necessary information regarding them:

  • Arc Reactor (Model I)
  • Arc Reactor (Model II)
  • Arc Reactor (Model III)

docs.title: Core
docs.text:
The Arc Reactor is obtained via crafting with x2 Iron and Gold, 2 Lead Circuits, 2 Iron Circuits, and a Redstone Flux Crystal in a crafting table

Uses:

  • The primary use of the Core is to be used in crafting the Arc Reactors
  • The Arc Reactor Core can be also used to store 500 RF

Related Information:

  • The Arc Reactor core cannot be worn and is not usable to power Iron Man suits

docs.title: Model I
docs.text:
The Model I Arc Reactor can be obtained via crafting with x3 Arc Reactor Cores, x4 Gold and Iron Circuits and x6 Iron with a blueprint book in a tailoring table.

Uses:

  • The Model I Arc Reactor can store 10,000 RF and is used to power Iron Man Suits in order to use their abilities
  • When charged with at least 100 RF, the reactor becomes self-sustaining and will slowly generate power in inventory, more when equipped.

Relevant Information

  • To power an Iron Man Suit, the arc reactor needs to be equipped in the curios:body slot.

docs.title: Model II
docs.text:
The Model II Reactor can be obtained via crafting with x5 Arc Reactor Cores, x2 Diamond Circuits, x4 Netherite Circuits, x2 Lead Flux Capacitor, x8 Iron with a blueprint book in a tailoring table.

Uses:

  • The Model II Arc Reactor can store 25,000 RF and is used to power Iron Man Suits in order to use their abilities
  • When charged with at least 100 RF, the reactor becomes self-sustaining and will slowly generate power in inventory, more when equipped.

Relevant Information

  • To power an Iron Man Suit, the arc reactor needs to be equipped in the curios:body slot
  • This Arc Reactor's recipe becomes unlocked after crafting the Model 9 suit.

docs.title: Model III
docs.text:
The Model III Arc Reactor can be obtained via crafting with x10 Arc Reactor Cores, x2 Nether Stars, x4 Titanium and Netherite Circuits, x2 Quartz Flux Capacitors, x12 Iron with a blueprint book in a tailoring table.

Uses:

  • The Model III Arc Reactor can store 50,000 RF and is used to power Iron Man Suits in order to use their abilities
  • When charged with at least 100 RF, the reactor becomes self-sustaining and will slowly generate ppower in inventory, more when equipped.

Relevant Information

  • To power an Iron Man Suit, the arc reactor needs to be equipped in the curios:body slot.
  • This reactor is unlocked after crafting the Model 50 suit.

docs.title: Model IV
docs.text:
The Model IV Arc Reactor can be obtained via crafting with x15 Arc Reactor Cores, x2 Nether Stars, x4 Titanium and Vibranium Circuits, x2 Vibranium Flux Capacitors, and x12 Iron with a blueprint book in a tailoring table.

Uses:

  • The Model IV Arc Reactor can store 100,000 RF and is used to power Iron Man Suits in order to use their abilities
  • When charged with at least 100 RF, the reactor becomes self-sustaining and will slowly generate power in inventory, more when equipped.

Relevant Information

  • To power an Iron Man Suit, the arc reactor needs to be equipped in the curios:body slot.
  • This Arc Reactor's recipe becomes unlocked after crafting the Model 70 suit.

docs.title: Falcon Wings (Base)
docs.text:
The "Falcon Wings (Base)" can be obtained by crafting x4 Iron Ingot, x2 Golden Circuit, x1 Diamond Circuit and x1 Quartz Flux Capacitor.

Uses:

  • Equip your Wings to the curios:back slot, and open them by using the Ability Slot 1. After opened them you can fly by pressing jump button twice.
  • You can boost your flight with your second ability while in the air.
  • Base Flight Speed: 0.5
  • Boosted Flight Speed: 1

Related Information:

  • For using the Falcon Wings you need to charge them with an RF charger or any mod that charges RF.
  • Max RF this item can hold is 25,000
  • You can't use this item with any of the Arc Reactors.

Falcon Wings(Base) when they are activated:

docs.title: Falcon Wings (Vibranium)
docs.text:
The "Falcon Wings(Vibranium)" can be obtained by crafting a Falcon Wings(Base), Vibranium Circuit and a Vibranium Template inside a smithing table.

Uses:

  • Equip your Wings to the curios:back slot, and activate them by using the Ability Slot 1. After activated them you can fly by pressing jump button twice.
  • You can boost your flight with your second ability while in the air.
  • You can dash with your second ability in the ground while your wings are closed.
  • You can use your Vibranium Wings to block any incoming attack for a short period by crouch using your third ability.
  • You can throw explosive Vibranium Feathers by using your third ability. For using this ability you need to insert Vibranium Feathers to your wings, use the third ability while holding the Vibranium Feathers in your mainhand for inserting them. Max Feather you can store is 128.
  • Base Flight Speed: 0.8
  • Boosted Flight Speed: 1.5

Related Information:

  • For using the Falcon Wings you need to charge them with an RF charger or any mod that charges RF.
  • Using Boosted Flight will use more RF energy.
  • Max RF this item can hold is 50,000
  • You can't use this item with any of the Arc Reactors.

Falcon Wings(Base) when they are activated:

docs.title: Genetic
docs.text:

Uses:

You need to power the Collar by Crouch + Right-Clicking in your mainhand. Doing it again will turn it off.

Right-Click a target whose health is below 50% HP to equip it to them, this will result in the collar becoming bound to them, stopping them from using their powers.

You can remove this collar with one of the Keys depending on the Security Level.

You can increase the security of the Collar with a Inhibitor Module (Security).

docs.title: StarkTech Watch
docs.text:
StarkTech Watch can be obtained via crafting with x4 Netherite Circuit, x4 Diamond Circuit, x6 Iron Ingot, x1 Glass Pane and x8 Redstone Dust with a blueprint book inside a tailoring table.

Uses:

This watch gives you ability to store your Iron Man(Non Nano Tech and Non Hulkbuster) type Suits inside it.

Equip this watch in curios:hands and crouch-right click while wearing an Iron Man(Non Nano Tech and Non Hulkbuster) type Suit to save in watch., then do the same to retrieve it.

docs.title: Advanced Tachyon Device
docs.text:
The Advanced Tachyon Device can be obtained via crafting with x1 Prototype Tachyon Device and x3 Titanium Circuit inside a crafting table:

Uses:

  • Wearing this device can increase your speed as a Speedster whenever you activate your speed.
  • Equip your Tachyon device to the curios:body slot, and activate them by using the Ability Slot 1.
  • Theres 10 Speed level. You can increase your speed by using your second ability non-crouched, and decrease it with crouch using the second ability.
    • Extra speed gained from each level are: 100% / 200% / 300% / 400% / 500% / 600% / 700% / 800% / 900% / 1000%

Related Information:

  • For using the Tachyon Device you need to charge them with an RF charger or any mod that charges RF.
  • Using higher levels of speed will use more RF energy.
  • Max RF this item can hold is 50,000.
  • This device is small enough to be hidden when worn.
  • This device can only be useable by Speedsters. Speedster that can use this device are:
    • Speedforce Users
    • Speed Mutant

docs.title: Prototype Tachyon Device
docs.text:
The Prototype Tachyon Device can be obtained via crafting x4 Iron Blocks and x4 Tachyon Reactor inside a crafting table:

Uses:

  • Equip your Tachyon device to the curios:body slot, and activate them by using the Ability Slot 1.
  • Using this device will increase your speed significantly.
  • Theres 10 Speed level. You can increase your speed by using your second ability non-crouched, and decrease it with crouch using the second ability.
    • Extra speed gained from each level: 100% / 200% / 300% / 400% / 500% / 600% / 700% / 800% / 900% / 1000%

Related Information:

  • For using the Tachyon Device you need to charge them with an RF charger or any mod that charges RF.
  • Using higher levels of speed will use more RF energy.
  • Max RF this item can hold is 50,000.
  • This device will show on your chest and will give you a pale cyan lightning trail.

docs.title: Full Power Tier List
docs.text:
The following list includes a full Tier list of all the Main powers currently in the addon. While we will do our best to keep this list up to date as new powers come out, there may occasionally be a power or two missing from the list. The criteria being used to evaluate the tier placement of a power are Combat-based Abilities, Traversal Abilities, and overall Versatility. The placement on the tier list is solely based on FSang18's and the Tester's opinions on the above-mentioned subjects, and thus there may be areas that others do not agree with. The powers are in alphabetical order within a tier's list, not ranking within a tier.

docs.title: Combat Techniques
docs.text:
"Combat Techniques" is a term used to describe powers obtainable that cannot be stacked with each other, but can be used in tandem with the Main and Secondary Powers. Combat Techniques can be upgraded via their own Skill Point system. For getting acces to the Combat Techniques you need a Knowledge Scroll(Combat).

Knowledge scroll(Combat) is an item used to access the combat system. Obtained by crafting it with an Basic Fabric(Blue), 3x Bottle o' Enchanting and 4x Paper.

  • After using it, you need to go to the abilities menu and choose the fighting style you prefer, options being:
    • Combat Specialist Stealth
    • Combat Specialist Brute
    • Combat Specialist Martial Artist
  • To progress in your combat styles you need to activate your combat mode with [Ability 1] keybind and attack(Left-click/Right-click) aggresive mobs or players, with each hit giving varying xp per hit 1-3. Upon reaching 500 xp you will get your Combat Skill Point respective to your style.
  • You can remove your current Combat Style and equip new one with a new scroll, but your progression on your previous style will be forgotten. Your unused Combat Style Points will remain when you forget your previous Combat Style.

  • To remove your combat style, you need to craft Doctrine of Stillness(Combat) with Basic Fabric(Red) 3x Bottle o' Enchanting and 4x Paper.

    * You can use both this add-on Basic Fabric(Blue/Red) and Palladium colored Fabrics.

    * Alternatively, you can use both scrolls for crafting their opposite version with a singular piece of fabric and bottle o' enchanting.

    * Although all of the Combat Styles can be used by themself, they are meant to be used with either Main and Secondary powers, and they all compatible with every single one of them. * You cannot have two Combat Styles at the same time.

docs.title: Combat Specialist Brute
docs.text:
Choose to specialize in a Heavy-Based combat system, focusing on your strong, but slow attacks, and enchancing your defense. You hit like a truck, but you move and swing like one too.

Brute Skill Tree:

  • Heavy Combat - Passively increases your damage output in combat mode by 1. Cost: 2x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Heavy Combat Level 2 - Passively increases your damage output in combat mode by 2. Cost: 3x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Combat Brawler's Block - This ability can be activated by pressing [Ability 1] keybind this allows you to block any damage for up to 5 seconds. Cost: 2x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Combat Brawler's Block Level 2 - Doubles the time you can hold your block. Cost: 3x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Powerful Leap - This ability can be activated when sprinting, double jump in the direction you are looking at. On the landing you will be immune to fall damage, and you will create a non-damaging ground shake, but all entities within its radius will be knocked back. Cost: 3x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Powerful Leap Level 2 - increases Powerful Leap range and knocks back entities in the landing radius further. Cost: 5x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Brawler's Ironhide Defense - This ability can activates if you held your Brawler's Block for at atleast 3 seconds, on activation, it will grant you Resistance II effect for 5 seconds. You cannot use Brawler's Block when you have Resistance effect. Cost: 3x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Ironhide Defense Level 2 - You will get Resistance III effect for 8 seconds after you held your block for at atleast 3 seconds. Cost: 5x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Double Fist - This ability can be activated by executing Right-click Left-click Right-click combo this will make your next Left-click attack into joined-hand strike, which will knock away targets you're looking at. Cost: 5x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Follow Up Strike - This ability can be activated by executing Double Fist combo and pressing spacebar after to leap into the direction you're looking at and dealing 8 damage to the entities in your way. Cost: 15x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Brawler's Grapple - This ability can be activated by pressing [Ability 2] keybind, you can grab and carry any entity for up to 30 seconds in a 1-3 range. Cost: 5x Brute Brawler Skill Points
  • Brawler's Throw(Crouch) - This ability can only activated when grabbing an entity, crouch and release your grab to throw your target at a great distance. Cost: 15x Brute Brawler Skill Points

Related Information:

While Brute Style possesses the most damage output, you will get slower attack animations and movement speed in combat mode as a tradeoff.

docs.title: Combat Specialist Martial Artist
docs.text:
Choose to specialize in a Martial Arts-Based combat system, striking with quick, low damage based attacks. Fly like a butterfly, sting like a bee.

Martial Artist Skill Tree:

  • Martial Artist Guard - This ability can be activated by pressing [Ability 1] keybind, to guard yourself from incoming damage. Cost: 2x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Guard Counter - This ability can be activated when you are using MA Guard, press Left-click within a second of Guard ending to deliver strong counter attack to the target which will also knock them back. Cost 5x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Jump Kick - This ability can be activated by pressing spacebar button and either Left-click or Right-click to kick your target. Cost 2x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Jump Kick Level 2 - this ability passively gives your kicks knockback up to 5-6 blocks distance. Cost 5x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Double Jump - This ability can be activated if you sprinting for atleast half a second and press spacebar, on your decent you need to press spacebar again will activate second jump to keep your momentum and leap you forward. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Wall Run - This ability can be activated by sprinting, you need to touch wall blocks to run along the wall while slowly sliding down. You will not take fall damage if you have been wall running. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Uppercut (Crouch) - This ability can be activated press either Left-click or Right-click to uppercut your target into the air. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Uppercut Level 2 (Crouch) - This ability passively increases how high you uppercut your target, up to 6 blocks. Cost 5x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Break-Fall Roll (Crouch) - This ability can be activated by crouching before you touch the ground, you will do a barrel roll to lower your fall damage. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Break-Fall Roll Level 2 (Crouch) - This ability passively increases your fall resistance to allow you to fall and survive from greater heights. Cost 5x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Cartwheel Kick - This ability be activated by executing Right-click Left-click Right-click Leftclick combo to flip over on one hand and kick your target, knocking them back at a low distance. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points
  • Martial Artist Cartwheel Kick Level 2 - This ability passively increases damage your Cartwheel Kick does at the end of your combo. Cost 3x Martial Arts Skill Points

Related Information:

Martial Arts Style gives you faster attack animations and the ability to jump up to 2 blocks in height passively while combat mode is active.

docs.title: Combat Specialist Stealth
docs.text:
Choose to specialize in a Stealth-Based combat system, taking control of the night to strike fear in your targets. Take down your targets in the shadows with secret.

Stealth Skill Tree:

  • Stealth Vanish (Crouch) - This ability can only be activated in combat mode, you become invisible at light levels 0-8 while crouching, no entity will be able to see you even after you attack them. Cost: 2x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Vanish Level 2 (Crouch) - You become invisible at light levels 0-14 while crouching. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Chokehold (Crouch) - This ability can be activated by having both hands empty looking at your target and pressing Right-click, you will inflict Weakness V and Slowness debuffs, also dealing 1 damage every second to the target. While holding someone in a chokehold, you can move them around for a duration of 10 seconds. Cost: 2x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Chokehold Level 2 (Crouch) - Doubles the time you can hold your target in a chokehold. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Damage (Crouch) - This ability passively increases your damage output from attacks in your combat mode while being undetected. Cost: 3x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Movement (Crouch) - This upgrade passively increases your movement speed while crouching, requires combat mode to be active. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Shadow Step (Crouch) - This ability can only be activated by pressing spacebar button and looking at your target in a 5-block radius, and you will instantly appear behind its back. Cost: 3x Stealth SP
  • Shadow Stab (Crouch) - After unlocking this ability executing Shadow Step will deal 5 damage to your target. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Target Tag (Non-Crouch) - This ability can be activated by pressing your [Ability 1] keybind while looking at your target in a 30-block radius for 15 seconds. Tagged target gets glowing effect and will take additional damage from stealth attacks. This ability can be used every 10 seconds. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Stealth Target Tag Level 2 (Non-Crouch) - Doubles the time your target is tagged. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Poisoning Feint (Crouch) - This ability will activate passively and grant Poison II debuff to the closest target in a 1-block radius with a 15 second cooldown. Cost: 5x Stealth SP
  • Poisoning Feint Level 2 (Crouch) - Doubles Poison debuff time. Cost: 5x Stealth SP

Related Information

  • Warden cannot see you in Stealth Vanish ability. He will be able to sniff you. And Shadow Step ability can trigger sculk sensors.
  • Stealth Style vanish works both at day and nighttime as it requires skylight value 0-8(14) meaning it can be used in other dimensions infinitely.

docs.title: Anti Matter
docs.text:
The "Anti-Matter" is obtained by using Anti-Matter DNA. This can be crafted by crafting it with an X-Gene, a Nether Star, an Augmented Human D.N.A Sample and a Super Soldier Serum inside a crafting table.

Stats

  • Maximum Health: 36
  • Maximun Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3.5 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 12
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 16
  • Sprint Speed: 300%
  • Flight Speed: 1.98

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-Based Grab" - Use your strength pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Telekinesis" - Use your stored energy to lift entities or blocks in front of you. Scroll up or down to change how far away the target is from you.
    • "Energy Infused Hands" - Passively drain the energy you've stored to dual wield and enhance your damage and knockback when both your hands are empty.
    • "Matter Conversion" - Change the form of iron/gold/diamond into various tools.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Anti-Matter Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Anti-Matter Blast" - Fire off a blast of raw Anti-Matter which can deal initial damage as well as decay overtime to targets hit. This ability can also destroy blocks on hit.
    • "Anti-Matter Beam" - Condense your Anti-Matter energy into a more refined, non-destructive, form as a beam. Entities hit by this beam will gain the decay effect.
    • "Anti-Matter Shield" - Use your Anti-Matter energy to create a shield in front of you to block incoming damage. Entities that come into contact with this shield will gain the decay effect.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Graviton Manipulation" - Manipulate the gravitons around you to either increase or decrease the gravity in entities in a 5x5x5 radius around you while draining your energy. When holding this ability key, scroll up to increase gravity, down to decrease gravity and release it to stop affecting gravity.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Anti-Matter Annihilation Mode" - For 30 seconds, surround yourself with Anti-Matter particles causing anyone who gets to close will gain the decay effect as well as increase your toughness and damage output by +10. This mode will heavily drain your energy.

Related Information:

  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • The Anti-Matter power's abilities all use energy, which is displayed next to your powers as a blue bar and drained by using various abilities. This bar will passively refill overtime.
  • This power has following passives;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power is loosely based off of Adam Brashear, a.k.a Blue Marvel.

docs.title: Artificial Necrotech
docs.text:
The "Artificial Necrotech" is obtained via crafting x1 Augmented Human D.N.A Sample, x4 Techno-Organic Metal Blocks, x2 Natural Symbiote, x2 Artificial Symbiote inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 18
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 6
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: 0.25 (0.75 when boosters on)

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Suit Up" - This allows you to enable the Necrotech armor.
  • Slot 1 (While transformed): "Summon Necrotech Tools" - This ability allows you to summon Necrotech tools. This ability has more purchase options which allows you summon tools following order Blade, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Shield.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Necrotech Spikes" - Fire off a spike of Necrotech that inflicts Blindness 2 and Wither 2 to the target hit.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Necrotech Tendrils" - Explode with a flurry of Necrotech Tendrils all around your body, damage everything in a 5x5x5 radius.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Necrotech Energy Beams " - Fire of a blast of energy created by your Necrotech.
  • Slot 4 (While flying): "Necrotech Boosters" - Using your Necrotech, form boosters around your legs to increase your speed while flying
  • Slot 4 (While not flying): "Necrotech Breaker Mode" - Using your Necrotech, grow into your Breaker mode which enchances your stats while activated at the cost of your abilites and flight for up to 60 seconds, but will grant weakness for 10 seconds and wither for 5 seconds when disabled.

Related Information:

  • You can't wear any armor while in Necrotech form.
  • While in Breaker Mode you will gain +14 armor, +6 toughness and +10 damage.

docs.title: Czarnian
docs.text:
The "Czarnian" is obtained via using Czarnian DNA. This can be crafted by crafting it with x2 Czarnian Fossil and a Smithing Template inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 46
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / Second
  • Armor Rating: 10
  • Armor Toughness: 6
  • Attack Damage: 16
  • Sprint Speed: 130%

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Block" - Block all incoming damage for a max of 5 seconds (full recharge is the same)
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Block Break" - This ability breaks a targeted block when held down for 5 / 3 / 1 seconds depending on the number of upgrades
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch + Crouch): "Target Grapple/Throw" - Grab an entity for up to 10 seconds (full recharge is the same), launching them in the direction you are looking if you press crouch while in use
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Striking Punch" - Strike with a hard punch, dealing +9 on to your normal punch damage for a max of 25 (Your hand must be empty)
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Super Ground Stomp" - Smash the ground using your super strength, exploding a large area beneath you

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power has the following passives;
    • Night Vision
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • Upon unlocking the last upgrade in the regen tree, gain a passive replenishment of hunger when your bar drops below 7, never hitting 0 (this replenishes most of the food and saturation bar).
  • This power is loosely based off of Lobo.

docs.title: Extremis
docs.text:
The "Extremis" is obtained via crafting x4 Arc Reactor Cores, x4 of any AI Chips, and a Super Soldier Serum inside a crafting table. This power focuses on providing buffs to wearing Stark Tech armors.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 26
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3.5 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 7
  • Sprint Speed: 130%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

in Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Not Transformed): "Enable Undersheath" - Call forth the nanites within the hollows of your bones to form a skin tight armor layer that gives you access to the rest of your Extremis Abilities.
    • Crouch use for retracting the nanites of your undersheath armor.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Transformed): "Wireless Connection" - Emit a wireless redstone signal from up to 10 blocks away in the direction you are looking. If used on an entity, it will give them 1 second of Tech Dampening.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Revitalization Drive" - Use up 2 saturation points in order to slightly heal yourself and repair the armor you are wearing. This repair effect is strengthened when wearing Stark Tech Armor. 
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Nanite Armory" - Link to one worn set of (non-nanotech and non-hulkbuster) based Stark Tech armor and store it within your nanites to be able to resummon it at will.

Related Information:

  • This power has 3 different visual appearences when active which can be selected via the Accessory menu.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power has the following passive abilities that can be unlockable:
    • Arc Reactor’s Last Spark - If you are wearing an arc reactor that is below 100RF, passively give it +100RF, allowing it to self sustain. You must have at least 3 saturation points for this to trigger.
    • Arc Reactor’s Battery - If you are wearing an Arc Reactor, you will generate an extra +20RF/second as long as you have more than 10 saturation points.
    • Iron Legion Integration - When wearing any set of regular Iron Man armor, gain an increase to your health, armor, toughness, and strength.
    • Hulkbuster Integration - When wearing any set of Hulkbuster armor, gain an increase to your health, armor, toughness, and strength.
  • This power is based off of Extremis Virus.

docs.title: Hell Spawn
docs.text:
The "Hellspawn" is obtained via the hellfire pact which can be crafted by surrounding 1 piece of paper with 8 hellfire souls (obtainable from killing wither skeletons as a rare drop) in a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 34
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 24
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 12
  • Sprint Speed: 125%
  • Flight Speed: 0.65

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Suit Up!" - This allows you to enable / disable the Hellspawn suit.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Cape Storage" - Wear Hellspawn Cape the crouch to gain access to your ender chest storage.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Summon Agony Axe" - With an empty mainhand, summon the Agony Axe to use as a weapon.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Necroplasmic Telekinesis" - Manipulate your Necroplasmic energy to lift entites and blocks.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Necroplasm Beam" - Shoot a beam of Necroplasm Energy at your target that deals 8 damage per hit.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Hallucikinesis Aura" - Confuse those around you, casting them into blind darkness, give them Nausea, Darkness, Blindnes and Weakness for 15 seconds.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Divine Mode" - Gain access to your Divine Mode and gain an increase to your stats, and faster flight. If your Karma falls below -1,000, you will no longer be able to access this form.
  • Slot 5 (Crouch): "Power Bestowal" - For 30 seconds at a time, temporarily grant your target a fraction of your power of Hellspawn. This is a crouch ability unless your karms falls lower than -1,000.

Related Information:

  • This power has following passives while your suit is active;
    • Night Vision
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Fire Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
  • You cannot wear any armor while your suit is active.
  • This power has an energy bar that will deplete as you use your ability’s and will refill when you kill hostile mobs. The energy gaining will be increase when you upgrade the appropriate skills. While in the Nether your energy passively recharges.
  • WARNING: If your energy reaches 0, you will be instantly transported to the Nether.
  • The Maximum limit of the Necroplasmic Energy is 10,000.
  • When in Divine Form you will gain the following stat bonuses:
    • Health: +8
    • Damage: +4
    • Armor: +6
    • Toughness: +8
    • Flight Speed: +0.25
  • This power will gain additional stat bonuses the less karma you get. You will gain the maximum stats at -10,000.
    • The bonus stats gained from max negative Karma's are:
      • Health: +16
      • Damage: +8
      • Armor: +8
  • This power is based off of Hellspawn.

docs.title: Kree Hybrid
docs.text:
The "Kree Hybrid" is obtained via using a Kree Hybrid DNA. This can be crafted by crafting it with an Kree Fossil, Smithing Template and a Augmented Human DNA inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 56
  • Maximum Healing/Second: 2 HP / 3 seconds
  • Armor Rating: 14
  • Armor Toughness: 6
  • Base Attack Damage: 13
  • Sprint Speed: 725%
  • Flight Speed: 2.25

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Block" - Block incoming damage for a short while.
    • "Photon Infused/Radiated Fists" - With an empty main/offhand, harness your stored energy into your hands, slowly draining your energy, but increasing your punch damage. Your damage increase you gain is dependent on the amount of energy you have. In Binary form, rather than increasing your physical damage, this will grant Wither II to any target you hit.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Photon Based/Radiated Energy" - Harness your stored energy into a beam of energy from your hand(s). Scroll while it is enabled to change the output which will increase the energy drain. In Binary Form, you will only have 1 output which is slightly weaker, but it will also apply Wither I to the target hit.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Photon Energy Explosion" - Release a large amount of your stored energy to detonate a photon-based explosion at your location. While in Binary form, your explosion will hit in a wider radius and will give wither to all targets within that radius.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod
  • This power has the following passives;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power has an energy bar with a max of 100,000.
    • This bar will slowly passively charge up to 80,000. Past that you will need to use the following methods:
      • This energy bar is passively filled up when you take damage and will constantly increase your armor stat the higher this value is. Using your abilities drains this stored energy.
      • As your armor stat increases with the addition of more stored energy, the harder it will be to store energy as the amount of energy added to your storage is determined by the amount of damage taken.
  • This power will have passively golden glowing eyes when flying.
  • When in Binary Form, your character gets a red tint througout their body
  • By unlocking the "Photon Overcharge: Binary" ability, whenever your energy levels reach 75k, passively transform into your Binary form, gaining an increase to your attack based on the amount energy you have, an altered moveset, and the ability to see the energies of all entities within 20 blocks of you. If your energy levels fall below 75k, you will revert back to normal.
    • You will gain a default +4 to your attack damage, as well as as addition +3 if your energy reached 80,000 or higher, and an additional +7 when you reach 100,000 energy stored.
  • This power is loosely based off of Carol Danvers, a.k.a Captain Marvel.

docs.title: Matter Absorption
docs.text:

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Matter Absorption - Retrieval" - When you have a an empty offhand, retrieve your stored material. You must unlock the "Matter Absotption Retention" ability to use this.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Matter Control - Tool" - With an empty mainhand, turn your mainhand into a pickaxe to help you mine. The level and speed will be based on the material you absorbed, as shown by the type of pickaxe that appears on your ability bar.

  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch, Blades): "Blade Swipe" - Swipe with both of your arms continuously to deal damage to a target in range.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch, Blades): "Disable Blade Arms" - Revert your Blade arms back to normal.

Related Information:

  • This power is loosely based off of Carl Kreel, a.k.a Absorbing Man.

  • The following blocks can be absorbed with the corresponding results gained from absorbing them:

    Block ID Ability minecraft:oak_log minecraft:stripped_oak_log minecraft:oak_planks minecraft:spruce_log minecraft:stripped_spruce_log minecraft:spruce_planks minecraft:birch_log minecraft:stripped_birch_log minecraft:birch_planks minecraft:jungle_log minecraft:stripped_jungle_log minecraft:jungle_planks minecraft:acacia_log minecraft:stripped_acacia_log minecraft:acacia_planks minecraft:dark_oak_log minecraft:stripped_dark_oak_log minecraft:dark_oak_planks minecraft:mangrove_log minecraft:stripped_mangrove_log minecraft:mangrove_planks minecraft:cherry_log minecraft:stripped_cherry_log minecraft:cherry_planks - More damage from fire - Increased jump height, and speed minecraft:grass_block minecraft:dirt minecraft:coarse_dirt - No Fall Damage minecraft:sand minecraft:red_sand - Knockback res - No movement in water minecraft:sponge - Passively absorb water in a 2x2x2 radius - Water breathing minecraft:honey_block minecraft:slime_block - Less player Gravity / higher leap - Passive Knockback punch minecraft:glowstone - Glowing / nightvision minecraft:stone minecraft:andesite minecraft:diorite minecraft:granite minecraft:cobblestone minecraft:mossy_cobblestone minecraft:smooth_stone minecraft:stone_bricks minecraft:mossy_stone_bricks - Heavier in water - Increased Armor toughness minecraft:gravel - Suffication immunity minecraft:red_sandstone minecraft:sandstone - Knockback res - Slowness in water minecraft:bone_block - Invis from mobs only minecraft:amethyst_block - Sounds effect immunity minecraft:magma_block - Passive Fire aspect - Fire immunity

docs.title: Radioactive Blindness

docs.title: Sand-Control
docs.text:
The "Sand-Control" is obtained via crafting the Sand-Infused Human DNA syringe and intaking it. This can be crafted by crafting with Augmented Human DNA, Dune Armor Trim and a Sand Block inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 36
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 14
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 10
  • Sprint Speed: 100%
  • Flight Speed: 1.5

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Sand Body - Transformation" - Change your form to that of sand, hardening your skin and increasing your density.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Sand Arm - Blade" - Shift your arm into a long Blade. This arm weapon variant will let you move the quickest, but deals the least amount of damage at +2.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Sand Arm - Fist" - Shift your arm into a large Fist. This arm weapon variant deals more damage that the blade at +6, but will make you move slower (Movement is set to 0.8).
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Sand Arm - Hammer" - Shift your arm into a Hammer. This arm weapon variant deals the most damage at +6, but will make you move the slowest (Movement is set to 0.5).
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Change Arm Weapon" - Toggle between the different arm weapons you available to use.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Density Control" - By adjusting the density of your entire body, you can slip through the cracks of some blocks that are made of sand.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Size Control" - By melding with sand or red sand in your mainhand, you can increase your size and strength at the cost of your movement speed. Crouch use this ability to get to normal size. Gained stats at maximum sizes are;
    • Strength: +16
    • Armor: +16

Related Information:

  • When coming into contact with any water source, this power will have a physical appearance change and become much slower.
  • While on fire, this power will have a physical appearance change into glass and be unable to move until no longer on fire.
  • This power is loosely based off of William Baker, a.k.a Sandman.

docs.title: Shazam
docs.text:
The "SHAZAM" is obtained via trading a Wizard villager for a Shazam Staff, then typing "Shazam" into the chat, to say the wizard's name and claim his power.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 56
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 25
  • Armor Toughness: 10
  • Base Attack Damage: 15
  • Sprint Speed: 850%
  • Flight Speed: 1.8

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Blessing of Mercury" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Speed of Mercury Barrage" - Rapidly punch your target with both hands. This ability scales with your strength output.
    • "Speed of Mercury Dash Strike" - Use your speed to instantly close in on your target before delivering a power strike to anything in your way. This ability has a range of 10 blocks.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Blessing of Zeus" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Power of Zeus" - Use your power to channel The Living Lightning into a beam from your hands.
    • "Lightning Chain" - Use your power to channel The Living Lightning to call a strike of lightning at your target which will then chain to the next nearest entity to your target. This can strike up to three targets per use.
    • "RF Charging" - Use your power to channel The Living Lightning to charge the RF of any item in your main or offhands.

Related Information:

  • While transformed type SHAZAM! into the chat, scream the name of the wizard that grants your power to unleash a devastating attack of lightning, striking everything, in your vacinity at the cost of being dampening afterwards for 1 full minute.
  • This power has following passives while your suit is active;
    • Night Vision
    • Explosion Immunity
    • Lightning Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • You cannot wear any armor while your suit is active.
  • This power has different suit options it can choose from in the Accessory menu for when they are transformed.
  • Typing "Shazam" into the chat will allow you to toggle on/off the suit and gain access to your abilities. If you are underwater, your word will be sent of into a bubble which will trigger your transformation when it reaches air, as long as you are within 30 blocks of it when it pops.
  • This power has a color slider in the power menu for changing your costume color.
  • This power is loosely based off of Billy Batson, a.k.a Shazam.

docs.text:

Radioactive Spider Serum Recipe

docs.text:

  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 10
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 10.5
  • Sprint Speed: 275%
  • Flight Speed: 1.38

Main Abilities:

    • "Strength-Based Grab" - Use your strength pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Tendrils" - Fire off a tenril of Golden Ichor to pull your target towards you, applying Slowness II and Weakness II for 3 seconds.
    • "Liquid Metal Beam" - Fire a beam of pure Liquid Metal which can cause fires and burns targets hit.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Golden Ichor Weapons" - Summon your Golden Ichor Weapons, divine weapons that will deteriorate and damage any that aren't of Asgardian decent. Select your weapons using the Ichor Weapon Wheel. Summoning a weopon will cost you 2 Saturation Points. This weapons have passive fire aspect. Summonable Ichor Weapons are:
    • Xiphos, Sword of Stars
    • Golden Ichor Spear - You can throw the spear with crouch+left click
    • Golden Ichor Scimitar
    • Golden Ichor Axe
    • Golden Ichor Hammer
    • Golden Ichor Shiel
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Asgardian Warcry Rally - Unleash a powerful warcry that will grant all entities within 5 block radius the Strength II effect for 30 seconds. If the target(s) have any of the Asgardian powers, they will also be granted regeneration.

Ascension: Quenn of Hel

When your Karma is -500 or less, you will passively transcend into your "Quenn of Hel" form, adjusting your stats and changing your abilities.

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Hel Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-Based Grab" - Use your strength pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Hel Blast" - Fire a blast of your Hel energy that deals 10 damage and gives Wither III for 5 seconds.
    • "Hel Shadow Step" - Teleport yourself up to 10 blocks in the direction you are looking with a five second cooldown.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Ichor Weopons" - Summon your Ichor Weapons, divine weapons that will deteriorate and damage any that aren't of Asgardian decent. Select your weapons using the Ichor Weapon Wheel. Summonable Ichor Weapons are:
    • Golden Ichor Spear
    • Golden Ichor Scimitar
    • Golden Ichor Axe
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Hel's Embrace" - Using your Hel power empower yourself in the battle, using this ability will give you Strength II and Regeneration effect for 15 seconds.

Related Information:

  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod
  • Max Age: 150 days
  • This power gains various stats based on the amount of Minecraft days passed without dying, and the abilities unlocked via the Combat and Defense skill trees (stats additions below are based on Max Age):
    • Max Damage: +3.7
    • Max Armor: +3
    • Max Health: +3
  • This power is loosely based off of Aldrif Odinsdottir, a.k.a Angela.
