docs.title: Light Manipulation
docs.text:
The "Light Manipulation" is obtained via right-clicking a Galactic Cluster Sample in the End and waiting for a Cosmic Storm to strike you and up to four people.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 32
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N/A
  • Armor Rating: 6
  • Armor Toughness: N/A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 150%
  • Levitation Speed: 1.38

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Light Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot.
    • "Light Manipulation: Invisibility"- Manipulate ambient cosmic energy to bend light around you, making yourself invisible. This ability will give the Invisiblity effect for 2 second. This ability is toggleable.
    • "Light Manipulation: Invisible Air"- Manipulate ambient cosmic energy to bend light around you, making yourself and others around you in a 3x3x3 radius invisible. In return your movement speed will be heavily reduced. This ability can be used up to 10 seconds.
    • "Light Manipulation: Blindness" - Manipulate ambient cosmic energy to turn optic retinas invisible, causing blindness to targets hit. This ability gives target Blindness II and Darkness II for 5 second.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Psionic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot.
    • "Psionic Hyperspace Force Field" - Through concentration, project an invisible field of psionic force drawn from Hyperspace. This shield will block all incoming damage, but lower your mobility when enabled.
    • "Psionic Hyperspace Shockwave" - Use your Force Field energy directed towards an entity to hit them with a heavy force, and knock them back as well.
    • "Psionic Hyperspace Telekinesis" - Through concentration, project an invisible field of psionic force drawn form Hyperspace to lift and manipulate entities. Scroll up or down while active to change the grab range.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Energy-based Internal Damage" - Create Force fields inside a target to deal -4 of internal damage which bypasses armor, per second. While this ability is enabled, your movement will be heavily reduced and you will not be able to use any of your 2nd slot abilities.

Relevant information:

  • When 50% or less of Max Health, you will gain the ability to detect all negative karma-based entities within 20 blocks. The range become 30 if blinded.
  • When invisible your armor will be hidden but your shadow will not.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power is loosely based off of Susan Storm, a.k.a Invisible Woman.

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrogenesis: Flaming Meteor" - Dash in the direction you are looking igniting things around you with your high temperature, and dealing damage to any entity that gets too close.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrogenesis: Flaming Stream" - While fully in flames, shoot a large beam of flames at your target. Scroll while firing to change the output of your flames at the cost of overheating quicker. If at max output, you no longer smelt blocks, but instead break any non-fireproof blocks.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrogenesis: Flame Tornado" - Create a Flaming Tornado up to 10 blocks away in the direction you are looking. Any entity within 5 blocks will be tracked by the tornado and take fire damage based on proximity to the tornado. After 15 seconds, the tornado will extinguish itself.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrogenesis: Super Nova" - Increase the temperature of your body to burn away the surrounding area. Scrolling while active can raise your temperature, damage output and range at the cost of increasing your overheat bar.

Relevant information:

  • This power has an "Overheat" bar attached to it. When this is full, you will be unable to use your powers for up to 30 seconds.
    • When underwater, or in rain, your overheat bar will increase slower.
  • WARNING: Any armor that is not fireproof will burn when you fully transform. The list below are armors that are safe to wear;
    • Netherite armor
    • Fantastic Four Armor (Base)
    • Any Future Foundation Armor (Base)
    • God Emperor Doom Armor
    • Savitar Armor
    • Any Uru-Based Armor
  • This power can have it's abilities toggled on / off by typing "Flame On" / "Flame Off" in the chat.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch, Transformed): "Strength-based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Swift Thunder Clap" - Fire off a Thunder Clap, quickly allowing for you to use it again after a shorter cooldown. This attack has a lower range, but will still grant sound poisoning to those hit. This ability has a 3 second cooldown.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Gamma Irradiated Fists" - Infuse your fists with your Gamma Radiation for 30 seconds. Punching any target while enabled will deal wither damage over time to them.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Controlled Ground Smash" - Quickly smash the ground at your feet for a smaller radius AOE attack that also knocks nearby entities back.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Controlled Gamma Breath" - Channel your Gamma Rays as a potent beam which can apply wither to targets hit by it. When you release the beam, regardless of how long you've used it, there will be a 10 second cooldown before you can use it again.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers while transformed.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor or equip any item in the curios slot when transformed.

  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Thunder Clap Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot.
    • "Thunder Clap" - Clap your hands together to create a shockwave dealing Sound Damage to those nearby. If used on a fire, it can be extinguished.
    • "Destructive Thunder Clap" - Wind up your clap more to demolish the area in front of you and apply sound poisoning. This ability has less range but hits harder than the base Thunder Clap
    • "Full Powered Super Punch" - Punch a target within range with a powerful, full force, strike. This ability scales with your strength stat.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): Ground Smash - Create a non-destructive shockwave with your fists to knock targets in front of you back, and deal damage.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): Worldbreaker Mode - Using your stored up energy, enter your Worldbreaker state, changing your moveset and increasing your Attack, Armor and Toughness stats. This will drain your energy when active, and will de-transform you for a full minute when deactivated whether done manually, or from running out of energy.
    • Worldbreaker Crushing Grasp - Grab an entity you are looking at in front of you. While held, the target will be squeezed, having damage dealt to them over time.
    • Worldbreaker Destructive Leap - Hold to charge a powerful leap in the air, up to 3. Every level of your leap higher than 1 will cause an explosion where you jumped from.
    • Worldbreaker Massive Thunder - Clap your hands together with all your might creating a large AOE force to knockback and damage enemies that are too close. This will also create an explosion centered on your location when used.
    • Worldbreaker Radiated Aura - Drain your Worldbreaker energy to create an aura of Gamma radiation around you. While active, you will push back any entity that gets too close to you, and deal damage to them.

Related Information

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers while transformed.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor, use anything or hold any items in main / off hand while transformed.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • When below %50 HP you start producing energy for the Worldbreaker Energy.
    • Max Worldbreaker Energy: 100,000
  • This power has the following passives while in Hulk form;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • When transformed, this power can't wear armor and use both their mainhand and offhand.
  • This power can not be killed when in human form if Auto-Transformation is enabled but will instead change into Hulk form and gain a short burst of healing. Once the Controllable Transformation ability is unlocked, the automatic transformation can be toggled on/off. Once this happens you will be forced to remain transformed for a full minute.
  • This power is loosely based off of Bruce Banner, a.k.a Hulk.

docs.title: Adventures
docs.text:
The "Kryptonian - Adventures" is obtained via using Kryptonian (Adventures) DNA. This can be crafted by crafting it with x2 Kryptonian Fossil and a Smithing Template inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 56
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 12
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: 15
  • Sprint Speed: 850%
  • Flight Speed: 2

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Super Ground Punch" - Using your strength punch the ground below you ca non-destructive explosion on the ground at your feet. This will knock entities away and deal AOE damage base on how close they are to you
    • "Super Air punch" - Using your strength to punch through the air, with an empty mainhand, creating a powerful impact that can destroy blocks. This ability scales with your strength
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Ranged Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Kryptonian Frost Breath" - Freeze the air you blow out of your mouth. Second Output can freeze blocks, Third output can freeze blocks and targets. While active, you can scroll to change the output. Higher output will drain solar energy more than lower outputs.
    • "Kryptonian X-ray vision" - Gain the ability to see entities within a 60 block radius. Scrolling while active can allow you to change between being able to see All, Players, Passive, Hostile entities. You will also gain the passive ability of Night Vision when you are below light level 10.
    • "Kryptonian Heat vision" - Fire off heated beams from your eyes to deal fire damage to your target. Second output can ignite certain blocks and fuel furnace-tyoe blocks, third output will also create fires where it hits. The higher the output, the more solar energy it will cost
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Bioelectric Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to use your abilities in your third slot. You need to hover over the abilities and click them for using it. The Abilities for the third slots are:
    • "Kryptonian Bioelectric Aura" - Consume your solar energy to increase your base armor toughness by +12, Knockback resistance 100%, and attack knockback +5 for as long as it is active, at the cost of heavy solar drain.
    • "Kryptonian Bioelectric Shield" - Consume your solar energy to create a shield of bioelectric energy in front of you to protect those who are behind it.
    • "Kryptonian Bioelectric Wave" - Consume your solar energy to explode your bioelectric energy outward, shocking and dampening all tech in a 10x10x10 energy around you (including your own tech)

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power has the following passives;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Projectile Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • Max Solar Energy: 900,000
  • Coming into proximity with any Kryptonite tools / blocks or items can cause the user to rapidly have their solar energy drained. All outputs (Heat vision and Freeze Breath) are reset to 1 and gain slowness. While in kryptonite poisoning you will lose all of your armor, toughness and attack damage bonus from this power. You cant use your powers in your 3rd ability wheel while you are effected. If the user is out of solar energy, and they still have the Kryptonite Poisoning effect, they will begin the lose hunger rapidly until the effect wears off.
  • When on the ground and crouching, the scroll wheel can be used to increase / decrease the movement speed percentage. When in the air the scroll wheel can be used to increase / decrease the flight speed percentage.
  • This power can gain solar energy faster by flying up to the Y level 500.
  • This power gains various stats based on the amount of Solar energy stored up. (Stats additions below are based on full solar energy):
    • Attack Damage: +18
    • Armor Rating: +18
  • This power is loosely based off of Kal-El, a.k.a Superman from My Adventures with Superman Show.

docs.text:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Tactile Telekinesis - Blast" - Launch a powerful blast of Tactile Telekinetic energy which deal 8 damage, and will bounce off walls
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Tactile Telekinesis - Stun" - Stun entities within a 3x3x3 radius around the user with the "Tactile Telekinesis Stun" effect for 8 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Tactile Telekinesis - Area Stun" - Stun entities within a 10x10x10 radius around the user with the "Tactile Telekinesis Stun" effect for 3 seconds, but will lock both stun abilities while on cooldown for 10 seconds.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Frost Breath" - Use your Kryptonian lungs to chill the air you breathe. This ability deals damage based on the output level as follows: 1 / 2 / 4. Grants the freezing effect at output level 3. The higher the output level, the more solar energy is drained on usage.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Change Frost Breath Output" - Crouching will allow you to enabled the ability to change your Frost Breath Output. After enabling, use the scroll wheel to change the output higher or lower. Activating the ability again will lock the scroll function for your output, granting the use of the scroll wheel again.

docs.title: Green Martian
docs.text:
The "Green Martian" power is obtained via using Czarnian DNA. This can be crafted by crafting it with Martian Fossil, Netherite Smithing Template and x1 Nth Metal Block inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 36
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 14
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 14
  • Sprint Speed: 110%

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Telekinetic/Telephatic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Martian Telekinesis" - Use your Psychic power to move blocks and entities with your mind up to 10 blocks away.
    • "Martian Psionic Strike" - Use your Psychic power to blast your target and deal +3 psionic damage to them over time.
    • "Psionic Vertigo" - Hit your target with a Psychic blast to affect their cognitive functions, slowing them down and giving them nausea.
    • "Mental Detection" - Use your Telepathy to uncover any / all powers your target within 20 blocks posesses.
    • "Mindless Attack" - Use your Telepathy to force your target to mindlessly attack anything they are looking at for 10 seconds.
    • "Telepathic Detection" - Using your telepathic powers, detect those around you in a 20 block range.
    • "Telepathic Pacify" - Using your telepathic powers, hide your presence from hostile mobs.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Self Control Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Martian Intangibility" - Use your Martian abilities to phase through solid blocks. You will not be able to deal any physical damage while phasing. Flying will allow you to phase through the ground.
    • "Martian Matter Repair" - Use your Martian Physiology, consume your saturation to repair any armor worn.
    • "Martian Invisibility" - Rewrite your Martian Physiology to become invisible to those around you.
    • "Skin Quick Change Slots" - Save up to 5 skins to quickly turn into later without needing the command each time. Use the "/FSang.Skin Slot" command to set your skin slots, but this will not allow for the green overlay that can be toggled via the normal command. Your skin will respect the base green / not green you currently have.
    • "Martian Size Change" - Rewrite your Martian Physiology to become larger or smaller. Hold the button then scroll up / down to control.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Martian Heat Vision" - Use your Martian abilities fire your Heat Vision from your eyes for 4 damage per hit up to 20 blocks away. This ability will not set any fires.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Martian Shift Form Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fourth slots are:
    • "Martian Form Shift: Arms" - Change your Martian Physiology to grow extra arms, which will respect any skin changes you have. While enabled, these arms will double your strength, but will also drain your saturation bar. This ability can only be used with empty main and off hands.
    • "Martian Form Shift: Marine" - Change your Martian Physiology to grow extra fins and gills. While enabled, these will let you breath uand swim faster underwater.
    • "Martian Form Shift: Villager" - Change your Martian Physiology to mimic the appearence of a Villager. In this form, you will be slower, and unable to use your main / off hands, but in return, you gain access to the Hero of the Village effect.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Martian True Form Reversion" - Revert yourself to your true form locking your access to use tools, armor and all of your abilities. In return gain +20 armor rating and +6 attack damage.

True Martian Form Reversion

Revert yourself to your true form locking your access to use tools, armor and all of your abilities. In return gain +20 armor rating and +6 attack damage.

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch, True Martian Form): "True Martian: Psychosis Attack" - While in your True Form, release a psychic attack so power, it shakes the earth, knocks entites back, and continues to deal psychic damage to them over 15 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch, True Martian Form): "True Martian: Ghost Form" - While in your True Form, become invisible and intangible at the same time for up to 1 minute total.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch, True Martian Form): "True Martian: Heat Vision" - While in your True Form, unleash a much more powerful version of your heat vision dealing 8 damage per hit up to 30 blocks away. This ability will not set any fires.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch, True Martian Form): "True Martian: Destructive Flight" - While in your True Form, harden your skin to increase your armor rating by +4, allowing you to destructivly fly through blocks when fast flying.
  • Slot 5 (Crouch): "Disable Martian form" - Revert your True Martian form back into your more Humanoid form, setting your abilities back to their normal functions.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod.
  • If within 5 blocks of any fire / soulfire / lit campfire / lit soul campfire, you will be given slowness, and weakness until you leave the vacinity.
  • This power is loosely based off of J'onn J'onzz, a.k.a Martian Manhunter.

    • "Stone Armor" - Using your Geokinetic powers, cover yourself in a hard layer of stone, lowering your movement speed but increasing your armor and toughness. This ability costs 2 Saturation points to be enabled, then may stay on until disabled. Stats gained from this form
      • Armor: +6
      • Toughness: +6
      • Sprint Speed: 105%
    • "Seismic Sense" - By focusing on your connection to ground beneath your feet, see entities that are moving and on the ground within a 60 block radius.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): “Earthquake” - Using your Geokinetic powers, create an earthquake at your location.

Related Information:

  • This power only use its abilities on the ground, except for Move Earth ability.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power is loosely based off of Tara Markov, a.k.a Terra.

docs.title: Chronokinesis
docs.text:
The "Chronokinesis" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 4
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Advance Time of day" - Hold this button to slowly advance the time of day at the cost of slowly increasing your overload bar. Upgrading it further will increase how much time you can advance by.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Adjust Time Control" - Hold this button while scrolling either up or down to change the amount of time you increase time by.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Chronokinetic Freeze" - Cast your chronokinetic abilities on any target you are looking at in a 5 block range, decreasing their time to a stand still.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Increase Target's Time" - Cast your chronokinetic abilities on any target you are looking at in a 5 block range, increasing their speed.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Chronokinetic Enhancements (Others)" - Gradually increase the time of any target you are looking at to allow them to move faster.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Chronokinetic Enhancements (Self)" - Gradually increase the time of yourself to allow yourself to move faster
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Chronokinetic Decay" - Rapidly age the cells in your target, forcing their body to wither away.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Chronokinetic Area Decay" - At the cost of rapidly increasing your energy usage, decay all targets within a 5x5x5 radius around yourself.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Chronokinetic Slash" - Slash through the air with raw chronokinetic energy which can decay any target caught in it's path.

Related Information:

  • To unlock the "Increase Target's Time" ability, you need to max out your "Advance Time of day" power skill line.
  • This power is loosely based off of Heather Tucker, a.k.a Tempo.

docs.title: Cryokinesis
docs.text:
The "Cryokinesis" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 34
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 HP / 1 Second
  • Armor Rating: 12
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 11
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight(Levitation) Speed: 1.25

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Cryokinetic Ice Form/Shape Ice Tools" - Harden your skin with ice. Crouch and activate this ability to disable your form. Create tools made of ice in your main hand, replacing any currently held items, Holding the keybind allows you to change the shape of the ice tool.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Cryokinetic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Ice Beam" - Launch a beam of ice at your target which can freeze them for 5 seconds, or create ice temporarily.
    • "Ice Blast" - Launch a blast of ice at your target which can freeze them for 3 seconds, or extinguish Fire/Campfire/Lava blocks.
    • "Ice Dome" - Create a dome of ice around you for 10 seconds before it disappears.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Cryokinetic Absolute Zero" - When transformed into your Ice Form create a large explosion of ice around you so cold that it damages anything that is near it. Crouch to change the output which affects the range/damage, but also increases the overall cooldown before you can use this ability again.

Related Information:

  • This power is compatible with custom accessories.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you a stronger Cryokinetic Ice Beam.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Cryokinetic Ice Beam.
  • This power is loosely based off of Robert Drake, a.k.a Iceman.

docs.title: Electrokinesis
docs.text:
The "Electrokinesis" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 2
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 4
  • Sprint Speed: 150%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Holding Drain Item): "Charge Self" - Using this ability you can drain energy from items to grant yourself power.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Holding Charge Item): "Charge Item" - Using this ability you can give your energy to whatever you are holding.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch, Empty Handed): "Electrokinetic Telekinesis" - Use your electricity to lift up any conductive block, or any target. Holding your target will slowly drain your electrokinetic energy. Your lightning will not harm any targets hit.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Electrokinetic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Electrokinetic" Blast - Using your electricity fire off a blast of energy at your target, shocking them. This ability will have longer range than your beams, but deals less damage. This attack can hit through multiple targets.
    • "Electrokinetic Beam" - Using your electricity fire off a beam of energy at your target, deals 8 damage per hit and shocks them. Using this ability will drain your stored energy.
    • "Electrokinetic Pulse" - Using your electricity fire off a pulse of energy around your location, shocking and grant the EMP effect to anything within the range..
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Electrokinetic Dash Strike" - Transform yourself into raw electricity, dashing in the direction you are looking. While performing this dash, your electricity form can grant the Shock Effect to entities you pass through. You will also be able to pass through solid objects during your dash.

Related Information:

  • You can passively draw energy from worn Arc Reactors after unlocking the "Electrokinetic Self Sufficiency" ability.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • Phoenix Force grant the player passive energy generation.
  • Copying this with Mimicry grants immunity to being shocked.
  • This power depends on Rf or Fe.
  • This power can also charge their energy using redstone dust or blocks.
  • This can be generated with mods such as: Simple Generators, Thermal Expansion, Immersive Engineering and more.
  • You can change your electricity color in power menu via color slider.
  • This power is loosely based off of Noriko Ashida, a.k.a Surge.

  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Energy Sphere" - Use your energy to create a sphere-like construct around you to halt incoming damage.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Energy Healing" - Manipulate the energy in your body's composition to heal yourself.

  • This power has the following passives;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • Phoenix Force grants you a higher overload limit.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Energy Saturation ability.

Main Abilities:

This ability will only be active when you hold something that can charge and throwable in your main hand. (Not every item can be used for this)
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Explosion Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Delayed Explosion" - When on the ground, charge the spot you are standing at, then have it explode 3 seconds after it is placed for a moderate sized explosion.
    • "Explosive Leap" - When on the ground, create a small, non-desctructive, explosion below your feet, propelling yourself in the direction you are looking.
    • "Explosive Knockback" - Create a small AOE explosion at your location by charging an item in your main and off hands. This will take 2 seconds to charge up and use both items.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Explosive Card Storm" - While holding at least 3 items in your mainhand, rapidly charge, then throw multiple projectiles at once.

Related Information:

  • You are not immune to your own(or any) explosion.
  • This power will turn your eyes black and red.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.

The "Lupine" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / 1 Second
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 16
  • Sprint Speed: 200%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Activate Claws" - Use this to pop your claws, granting you higher unarmed damage and allowing use of your other abilities.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Lunge Attack" - Leap up to 20 blocks in the direction you are looking, dealing damage to any enemies you hit.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Heightened Senses" - Focus your senses and gain the ability to see an outline on nearby entities for 8 seconds, even through walls.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Wall-Crawling" - Toggle this to be able to climb walls while your claws are out.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Blood Bash" - Swing both of your arms to strike for a massive attack with a high cooldown.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Bloodlust" - Take damage to increase your bloodlust bar, then succumb to the hunger and increase your stats.

Related Information:

  • This mutation has a Bloodlust bar attacked to it, which will passively increase as you take damage, maxing out at 500.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you passive burning claws that deal fire damage on hit.
  • This power loosely is based off of Victor Creed, a.k.a Sabretooth.

docs.title: Magnetism
docs.text:
The "Magnetism" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: 0
  • Base Attack Damage: 5
  • Sprint Speed: 130%
  • Flight Speed: 1.0

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Magnetic Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Magnetic Telekinesis" - If your target is wearing any magnetic vanilla armor, Iron Man Armor, Scarab, or has Metal Skin / Skeletons, control their movements.
    • "Magnetic Item Pull" - Pull in any magnetic items on the ground within a 5x5x5 radius of you directly to you.
    • "Magnetic Ore Extraction" - Extract the raw material from any metallic ore, dropping the raw material in its place.
    • "Shape Metal" - Convert any metal tool into another tool, or change an ingot, raw ore, or ore block into any tool as well. This ability has upgrades which allow you to shape iron/gold/netherite/adamantium.
    • "Shape Metal - Repair Tools" - This allows you to repair tools that in your mainhand.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Magnetic Offensive" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Magnetic Ray" - Manipulate magnetic waves to create a beam of electricity that deals 10 damage per hit.
    • "Magnetic Repulsion" - Use the iron present in a target's body to push them up to 20 blocks away, dealing 1 damage.
    • "Electromagnetic Pulse" - Manipulate magnetic waves to scramble any technology within a 10x10x10 range for 20 seconds. This will also deal shocking damage for 5 seconds.
    • "Increase Gravity" - By adjusting the electromagnetic field around you, increase gravity for everything within a 10x10x10 radius around you. The closer the target is to you, the more they are affected.
    • "Decrease Gravity" - By adjusting the electromagnetic field around you, decrease gravity for everything within a 10x10x10 radius around you. The closer the target is to you, the more they are affected.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Electromagnetic Shield" - Create a powerful energy shield that encompasses your body, gaining +12 Armor, +12 Toughness and Arrow Immunity. While this is active, you cannot walk and your flight speed is reduced to almost nothing.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Levitate Sword / Remove Sword" - Levitate up to 5 iron swords above your head. If used with nothing in your main hand, this will allow you to retrieve one of the swords if it has not yet been fired.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Master of Magnetism: Sword Play" - Fire one of up to 5 iron swords you have prepared at an enemy for 15 damage.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Master of Magnetism: Embed" - Launch an iron nugget at your target, temporarily halting their movements. If the target is wearing If your target is wearing any magnetic vanilla armor, Iron Man Armor or Scarab crush them in it to deal damage. If the target is infused with adamantium, it will be ripped from them.

Related Information:

  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force will spawn a iron nugget at your inventory in designated times.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants a version of the Electromagnetic Shield ability.
  • This power is loosely based off of Max Eisenhardt, a.k.a Magneto.

docs.title: Power Negation
docs.text:
The “Power Negation” is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 24
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 2
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 2
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Dampening Aura" - Dampen all non-tech based powers within a 3 block radius of you for up to 10 seconds at a time.

Related Information:

  • This power has upgrades for:
    • Area of Effect: ( 3 / 5 / 8 / 10 Block)
    • Time Duration ( 10 / 20 / 30 Seconds)
    • Change activation key from hold to a toggle after purchasing the Dampening Aura Level 4.
  • This power also changes the user’s skin to a pale green color and yellow eyes. And you become short.
  • This power is based off of Mutant Leech.

docs.title: Pyrokinesis
docs.text:
The "Pyrokinesis" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 4
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Flame Touch" - Heat the air around your hands to produce fire, giving you Fire Aspect.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrokinetic Fireball" - Launch a ball of flame at an enemy within range, dealing 8 damage and igniting the ground.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Pyrokinetic Firestream" - Launch a stream of fire dealing 8 damage per hit and igniting the ground. Upgrading this to Enhanced Pyrokinetic Firestream allows you to shoot under yourself and soar upwards. Crouching causes this to instead slow your falls.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Smelt Ore / Cook Food" - Cook any vanilla food in your hand, or turn any ore in your hand into its respective ingot.

Related Information:

  • This power has a energy bar for using its abilities, you can't use any of the abilities while your bar is empty. You can charge your energy bar by crouching while on fire. This will absorb any fire beneath the user, extinguishing it as the user charges their reserves.
  • This power has following passives;
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
  • Having the Phoenix Force grants you passive energy generation.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants immunity to fire.
  • This power loosely is based off of St. John Allerdyce, a.k.a Pyro.

docs.title: Reality Warping
docs.text:
The "Reality Warping" is obtained via X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 4
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: 1.45

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Telephatic/Telekinetic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Telekinetic Hold" - Use your telekinetic powers to move an entity or block within 2 blocks of you that your are looking at. Once active, scroll up or down to move them up to 5 blocks away, or 1 block close.
    • "Spatial Travel - Short Range" - Teleport yourself up to 30 blocks in the direction you are looking with a one second cooldown.
    • "Psionic Strike" - Hit your target with a Psychic strike to mental damage to them over time.
    • "Power Detection" - Use your Telepathic powers to uncover any / all powers your target possesses.
    • "Telepathic Mental Cleanse" - Use your Telepathy to reset all of the abilities from a single target's current power. If they die or remove the effect within 5 minutes, they will not be affected. This ability has a very large cooldown.
    • "Reality Matter Conversion" - Change the form of Iron / Gold / Diamond / Netherite into various tools. This ability has upgrades for use of mentioned ingots.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Energy Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Energy Manipulation Beam" - Gain the ability to manipulate your stored energy into a powerful beam that deals 6 damage that goes through armor.
    • "Energy Manipulation Shield" - Gain the ability to manipulate raw energy into a powerful Ring-Shaped shield in front of you.
    • "Energy Manipulation Explosion" - Gain the ability to manipulate raw energy into a massive explosion of energy around you. This will take 5 seconds to build-up before it can be fired, and will heavily drain your energy.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Dimensional Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to use your abilities in your third slot. You need to hover over the abilities and click them for using it. The Abilities for the third slots are:
    • "Pocket Reality Storage" - Gain the ability to open a small portal into your pocket dimension to store your items in your own personal storage chest. This portal will remain open and draining your energy until you close it by activating the ability again from the ability wheel.
    • "Pocket Reality Travel" - Gain the ability to fully access your pocket dimension, sending only yourself there and back at will. You will always be returned to the exact location in the Overworld you left from.
    • "Multiversal Access Storage" - Gain the ability to tap into the Ender Dimension to access your Ender Storage remotely.
    • "Multiversal Access Travel" - Gain the ability to teleport yourself and any other entity within 2 blocks to designated locations, including dimensional travel via dimensional menu.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Reality Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fourth slots are:
    • "Powerhouse Mode" - Gain the ability to activate your PowerHouse mode at will. This will increase your stats moderately and you will induce Weakness 5 to all other entities in a 3x3x3 radius for 10 seconds. This ability will drain your energy heavily. Strength gained from this mode is depends on your energy level, other stats are flat increase and not tied to your energy level. This ability has upgrades for the stats and for the effect. At max Energy(for strength) and at max upgrade gained stats are:
      • Attack Damage: +20
      • Armor Rating: +15
      • Armor Toughness: +8
      • Maximum Health: +8
      • Knockback: +3
    • "Cosmic Dampening Technology" - Channel the power of reality to cause Tech on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to malfunction for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening Speed" - Channel the power of reality to cause Speedforce on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening Red Sun" - Channel the power of reality to cause Kryptonian DNA on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening Metaphysical" - Channel the power of reality to cause Cosmic / Magic users you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening Genetic" - Channel the power of reality to cause Genetic-based powers on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
  • Slot 5 (Crouch): "Cosmic Manipulaiton" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fifth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fifth slots are:
    • "Cosmic Energy Surge" - Levitate and hold targets within a 10x10x10 radius, dealing 1 damage per second.
    • "Cosmic Herald Creation" - Using your cosmic energy, gift a chosen individual increased stats and a fraction of your power for a period of time. As long as they have energy, they can retain the abilities, however there is no way for them to regain lost energy alone.
    • "Cosmic Gene Reconstruction" - Use your cosmic powers to reconstruct someone's DNA. If they can survive for 10 minutes with the effect you grant them, they will be given a random X-Gene Mutation. Looking straight down will allow you to use it on yourself. This ability needs to be re-purchased after each use.
    • "Cosmic Reconstruction(Stored)" - Use your cosmic powers to reconstruct an empty bottle in your mainhand into an X-Gene mutation which can only produce a low-tier Mutations. After 3 uses, this ability needs to be re-purchase.

Related Information:

  • This power has an energy bar that will deplete as you use your ability’s and will refill passively over time.
    • The Maximum limit for Reality Energy is 1,000,000.
    • Your energy will replenish faster when you are in your pocket dimension after purchasing the Pocket Reality - Energy ability.
  • You have a increased healing in your pocket reality after purchasing the Pocket Reality - Healing ability.
  • This power can understand any language spoken, no matter which multiverse you are in after purchasing the Multiversal Access - Knowledge ability.
  • This powers one of the two powers that can travel other dimensions.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you faster energy generation, which stacks with your Pocket Dimension boost.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants a version of the Pocket Dimension - Storage ability.
  • This power is loosely based off of Franklin Richards, a.k.a Powerhouse.

docs.title: Regenerative Healing
docs.text:

  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Related Information:

  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you a max of 1 Heart / 0.125 Seconds, and also removes the burnt appearance.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a healing factor of 1 Heart / 1 Second.

docs.title: Self Detonation
docs.text:
The "Self Detonation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 4
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Charge" - Compress your energy to build up enough for an explosion. This ability has upgrades that increse your charging speed.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Detonate" - Use your energy to explode, damaging the area and entities around you. This ability is highly destructive and will destroy blocks in a similar fashion to TNT. This deals anywhere from 10 to 46 damage, depending on a target's proximity to the center of the explosion. The radius varies from 5 blocks at Output 1 to up to 15 at Output 10.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Increase Detonation Output" - Increase your Detonation Output by 1, up to your highest unlocked output.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Decrease Detonation Output" - Decrease your Detonation Output by 1, to a minimum of 1.

Related Information:

  • This power has a energy bar for using its abilities, you can't use Detonate ability while your bar is empty.
  • This power has Explosion Immunity.
  • Having the Phoenix Force grants you passive energy generation.
  • This power is loosely based off of Eloise Phimister, a.k.a Negasonic Teenage Warhead. It takes inspiration from her movie counterpart and not her comic self.

docs.title: Size Manipulation
docs.text:
The "Size Manipulation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A

  • Base Attack Damage: 5
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Size Up" - Gain the ability to grow in size. The rate at which you grow can be increased by further upgrading this.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Size Down" - Gain the ability to shrink in size. The rate at which you shrink can be increased by further upgrading this.

Related Information:

  • This power allows you to change your size, becoming both larger and smaller. Due to its nature, you do not grow stronger or weaker at these sizes
  • This power shrinks in increments of approximately 0.25 and 0.5 blocks, down to a minimum of about 0.25 blocks.
  • This power grows in increments of approximately 0.25 and 0.5 blocks, up to a maximum of about 28 blocks.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Size Down ability that lets the player become 1 block tall with no sizes in-between.
  • This power loosely is based off of Scott Wright, a.k.a Micromax.

docs.title: Sonic Sound Manipulation
docs.text:
The "Sonic Sound Manipulation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Sonic Scream" - Scream in a high-pitched sound, harming targets in range for 3/6/8 damage per hit for up to 5/10/20 seconds. This ability also applies Sound Poisoning 2 for 4 seconds. This effect refreshes on every hit. The damage dealt and time you can scream for can both be upgraded. At Upgrade 2, you can unlock the ability to propel yourself upwards by screaming, or crouch and use it to slow your fall.

Related Information:

  • The sonic nature of this power's abilities well against powers with a vulnerability to certain frequencies, such as Symbiotes, Viltrumites, Kryptonians, Half-Kryptonians, Bone Claws and Lupine.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you a damage of 10 per hit as well as Phoenix flame particles on your scream.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants immunity to sonic sounds.
  • This power is loosely based off of Sean Cassidy, a.k.a Banshee.

docs.title: Speed
docs.text:
The "Speed Mutation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 30
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / 1 Second
  • Armor Rating: 6
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 5
  • Sprint Speed: 1100%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Activate Speed" - Gain the ability to run at speeds far faster than before. Unlike Speedsters, this power's speed can be increased only by sprinting and cannot be locked.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "High Speed Punches" - Punch as quick as you can at your target, this attack will scale to your damage output.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Arrow Catch" - When enabled, this ability will allow you to catch arrows in front of you.

Related Information:

  • This power gives you a after-image trail when your super speed is on.
  • This power can run on walls and on water once you purchase those skills.
  • This powers damage output will increase depending on your speed level.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force gives your after-image fire particles.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants a destroy speed of 3 when holding nothing.
  • This power is loosely based off of Pietro Maximoff, a.k.a Quicksilver.

docs.title: Superior Adaptation
docs.text:
The "Superior Adaptation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 3
  • Armor Toughness: 0
  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 150%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Related Information:

  • This power has no active abilities, it focuses on adapting the surrounding and surviving, it has the following passive abilities after purchasing them;
    • Adaptation: Head grants Night Vision, Water Breathing, and immunity to Poison, Nausea and Hunger.
    • Adaptation: Legs can grant Lava Walking, Slow Falling when airborne, and boosted swim speed.
    • Adaptation: Arms grants you strength, durability and toughness as you get lower on health.
      • These values increase as follows: When Health is between 11-14 (Str: +5, Arm: +5 , Tou: +5 ), 7-10 (Str: +10, Arm: +10 , Tou: +10 ), 3-6 (Str: +12, Arm: + 12, Tou: +12 ), 0-3 (Str: +20, Arm: +20 , Tou: +20 )
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you a boost of healing, although this effect has a cooldown.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants the ability to breathe underwater and in space (through Ad Astra compatibility).
  • This power is based off of Armando Muñoz, a.k.a Darwin.

docs.title: Telekinesis
docs.text:
The "Telekinesis" is obtained via X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: 0.8

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Telekinetic Hold" - Use your telekinetic powers to move an entity within 10 blocks of you that are lookin at. This ability can upgradable to reach max 30 range.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Telekinesis Blast" - Use your telekinetic powers to send blast of energy that deal 3 damage and knockback the target.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Telekinesis Aura" - Use your telekinetic powers to block yourself from incoming projectiles at the cost of not being able to use your other abilities while it is active.

Related Information:

  • This power has following passives when Telekinesis Aura is active;
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • Flight and Telekinesis Aura's color can adjustable in the power menu.
  • Using Phoenix Force change aura color to yellow and increase the damage and knockback of the telekinesis blast to 5 damage.
  • This power is loosely based off of Mutant Jean Grey.

docs.title: Telepathy
docs.text:
The "Telepathy" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 4
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Telephatic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Psionic Strike" - Hit your target with a Psychic strike to deal damage to them. Wearing Cerebro will increase the range and damage output.
    • "Telepathic Detection" - Using your telepathic powers, detect those around you in a 20 block range. Wearing Cerebro increases the range to 50, and gains the option to toggle between all entities only mutants, or only non-mutants.
    • "Telepathic Pacify" - Using your telepathic powers, hide your presence from hostile mobs.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Psionic Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Psionic Vertigo" - Hit your target with a Psychic blast to affect their cognitive functions, slowing them down and making them feel sick.
    • "Psionic Motion" - Hit your target with a psychic blast to affect their motion, temporarily halting their movement.
    • "Mass Psionic Motion" - Spread your reach to hit multiple targets in a 5x5x5 radius with Psychic energy to affect their motion, temporarily halting their movement.
    • "Psionic Senses" - Hit your target with a Psychic blast to affect their sense, temporarily blinding them and affecting their ability to touch other entities.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Psionic Lightning" - Use your Telepathy to channel the ambient Psionic energy in the air through a target having a physical effect. Wearing Cerebro increases the range and damage output.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Uncontrollable Movements" - Use your Telepathy to severely tamper with the movements of your target
  • Slot 5 (Crouch): "Master of Telephaty" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fifth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fifth slots are:
    • "Mindless Attack" - Use your Telepathy to force your target to mindlessly attack anything they are looking at for 10 seconds.
    • "Mental Detection" - Use your Telepathy to uncover any / all powers your target possesses.
    • "Master of Telepathy: Blank Slate" - Use your Telepathy to force all targets within 3 blocks to reset all of the abilities from their current power. If they die or remove the effect within 5 minutes, they will not be affected. This ability will need to be re-purchased after each use.

Related Information:

  • This power has the ability to change what color the psionic abilities are in the power menu.
  • If used with Phoenix Force the ability "Psionic Strike" gets an increase in damage and gives Psychic Damage for 6 seconds while Psionic Motion now lasts 20 seconds.
  • Copying this ability with Mimicry grants immunity to Psychic Damage.
  • This power also cannot function while the user wears any Magneto Helmet, nor will any of these abilities affect anyone else wearing any Magneto Helmets.
  • This powers telephatic abilites can be amplifiable by wearing Cerebro.
  • This power is loosely based off of Charles Xaviar, a.k.a Professor X.

docs.title: Teleportation
docs.text:
The "Teleportation" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 26
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 9
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 2
  • Sprint Speed: 110%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Short Range Teleport - Self" - This allows you to teleport up to 30 blocks in the direction you are looking with a cooldown of 0.5 seconds.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Short Range Teleport - Group" - You can teleport other entities around you, with you.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): " Short Range Teleport - Swap" - Teleport to your target and switch places with them up to 30 blocks.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Dimensional Teleport" - You can now teleport from your current position between the Overworld and the Nether with a 1 minute cooldown.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Saved Teleportation 1" - You can now teleport to a saved coordinate.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Enable Coordinate Entry 1" - Save the coordinates of a Location to teleport back to.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Saved Teleportation 2" - You can now teleport to Second a saved coordinate.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Enable Coordinate Entry 2" - Save the coordinates of a Second Location to teleport back to.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Saved Teleportation 3" - You can now teleport to Third a saved coordinate.
  • Slot 5 (Crouch): "Enable Coordinate Entry 3" - Save the coordinates of a Third location to teleport back to.

Related Information:

  • This powers final unlock allows you to teleport anywhere in the current dimension, to do so you just need to use the "/FSTP" Command.
  • This power has a color variant that will change your eyes and skin. Yellow Eyes and Blue Skin. Gray eyes and Red Skin. The color variant of the power will be random.
    • Commands for changing the color variants can be found on the Commands page.
  • This power is loosely based off of Kurt Wagner, a.k.a Nightcrawler and Azazel.

docs.title: Total Molecular Control
docs.text:
The "Total Molecular Control" is obtained via X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 50
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 23
  • Armor Toughness: 10
  • Base Attack Damage: 18
  • Sprint Speed: 300%
  • Flight Speed: 1.15

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot.
    • "Strength-Based Grab" - With an empty main / off hand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Telekinesis" - Gain the ability to use Telekinesis, allowing you to lift and throw entities with your mind. Hold the ability key and scroll to adjust the grab distance.
    • "Energy Shield" - Gain the ability to project a powerful Energy Shield, blocking incoming damage.
    • "Psionic Strike" - Gain the ability to use Telepathy, allowing you to project Psionic bolts at enemies.
    • "Size Alteration" - Gain the ability to alter your size, increasing your hitbox and physical strength.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Celestial Energy Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot.
    • "Energy Blast" - Gain the ability to project Energy Blasts at enemies.
    • "Celestial Explosion" - Gain the ability to create a powerful Celestial Explosion on impact.
    • "Celestial Beam" - Gain the ability to fire a concentrated Celestial Beam at your target.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Techno Genetic Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your third slot.
    • Techno-Organic Khopesh - Gain the ability to turn any Techno-Organic Ingot into a Khopesh, or any other tool.
    • Tech Dampening - Emit a Techno-Organic field that suppresses the technological abilities of nearby entities.
    • Genetic Dampening - Emit a Techno-Organic field that suppresses the genetic powers of nearby mutants.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Celestial Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot.
    • "Celestial Regeneration" - Gain accelerated Celestial Regeneration, healing wounds at an incredible rate.
    • "Celestial Teleportain" - Gain the ability to instantly teleport to a target location using Celestial energy.
    • "Celestial Portal" - Gain the ability to open Celestial portals, allowing you to travel vast distances instantly.
    • "Celestial Energy Transfer" - Gain the ability to transfer Celestial energy to anything in your mainhand that requires RF.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Gene Manipulation - Horsemen" - Manipulate the X-genes of nearby entities, temporarily granting them the enhanced abilities of your Horsemen.

Related Information:

  • To unlock ability slots 3 and on, the techno organic upgrade will have to be purchased with 64 Techno-Organic Blocks. When this upgrade is purchased all physical stats will increase.
    • Health: +8
    • Armor: +6
    • Toughness: +4
    • Strength: +2
  • This power can understand any language spoken, no matter which dimension you are in after purchasing the "Omnilingualism" ability.
  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • This power has following passives;
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power will change your apperance to a ash-like color and will alter your eyes. This appearance will change more upon infusing yourself with Techno-Organic Metal.
  • This power is loosely based off of En Sabah Nur, a.k.a Apocalypse.

docs.title: Winged Flight
docs.text:
The "Winged Flight" is obtained via X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 27
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 7
  • Sprint Speed: 150%
  • Flight Speed: 1.8

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Wing Attack" - Using you wings, attack your targets for 1 damage with range, if you have Arch-Angel unlocked, this will deal 10 damage and become a melee ability.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Wing Block" - Once you've unlock Arch-Angel, you can now block incoming attacks with your wings.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Feather Shot" - Once you've unlock Arch-Angel, you can now shoot razor sharp feathers at you targets dealing 5 damage and poison.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Sonic Scream" - Scream in a high-pitched sound and deal damage. This ability also applies Sound Poisoning 2 for 2 seconds. This effect refreshes on every hit.

Related Information:

  • You can change your color of your wings in Accessories menu.
    • Arch-Angel Transformation will grant you forced gray-blue colored skin and wings.
  • The "Arch-Angel Transformation" Costs 24 blocks of Techno-Organic Metal.
  • Phoenix Force grants you Yellow Burning Wings, this will burn your Techno-Organic Metal and revert you from your Arch-Angel form.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants wings.
  • This power is loosely based off of Warren Worthington, a.k.a Angel/Archangel.

docs.title: Bone Claws
docs.text:
Here You can find information regarding the three Bone Claw Variants:

  • Logan
  • Laura
  • Daken

docs.title: Daken
docs.text:
The "Bone Claws - Daken" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance. This variant has 2 outer hand claws, and 1 on the inner hand.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 30
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / second
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 11
  • Sprint Speed: 200%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Activate Claws" - Allows you to unsheathe your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Deactivate Claws" - Allows you to retract your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Block - With your claw out, hold your arms up to block incoming damage.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Pherokinesis - Scent" - Using your empathic pherokinetic abilities, mask your scent from hostile mobs around you for up to 10 seconds at a time. This ability has the following upgrade;
    • "Pherokinesis - Vision" - Upgrade your Pherokinetic abilities to mask you visually, and double the duration you remain masked.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Feral Senses" - Gain the ability to highlight entities within a 10 block radius for up to 10 seconds at a time.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Wall Crawling" - Gain the ability to toggle on / off your wall crawling capabilities while your claws are extended with this ability.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Feral Strike" - Swing both of your arms to strike for a massive attack dealing your current output + a strength 4 effect modifier with a high cooldown of 1 minute.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Mass Pherokinesis" - By inducing fear via your pherokinesis, grant the Weakness 5 and Nausea 5 effects to all entities within a 10x10x10 radius for 30 seconds
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch, Phoenix Force): "Phoenix Force Explosive Slash" - By unlocking the Phoenix Force, your final ability becomes a ranged slash which deals 12 damage and can set your target on fire from a distance and will create an explosion.

Related Information:

  • This power has passive Night Vision.
  • In addition, this variant cannot infuse itself with Adamantium.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you passive burning claws that deal fire damage on hit.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Bone Claws ability.
  • This power is loosely based off of Akihiro, a.k.a Daken.

docs.title: Laura
docs.text:
The "Bone Claws - Laura" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance. This variant has 2 outer hand claws, and one claw on each foot.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 28
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / second (0.5 / second with Adamantium Skeleton Infusion)
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 9 (15 with Adamantium Skeleton Infusion)
  • Sprint Speed: 200%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Activate Claws" - Allows you to unsheathe your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Deactivate Claws" - Allows you to retract your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Block - With your claw out, hold your arms up to block incoming damage.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Claw Grapple" - Grab a target in front of you within a 2 block range and deal 2 damage per second (4 with adamantium claws) to them while you hold them with your claws.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Feral Senses" - Gain the ability to highlight entities within a 10 block radius for up to 10 seconds at a time.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Wall Crawling" - The ability to toggle on / off your wall crawling capabilities while your claws are extended with this ability.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Hunter's Barrage" - Rapidly swing the claws on your arms and legs to quickly deal damage to your target based on your current output + a strength 1 effect.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Controlled Feral Rage" - Send yourself into a violent rage, increasing the damage of all of your abilities by +4, your speed by 0.5, and increasing your healing to an addition 0.5 Heart / Second at the cost of being slightly harder to control due to your screen shaking.

Related Information:

  • This power has passive Night Vision.
  • In addition, it can infuse itself with 4 Adamantium Blocks to gain increased damage with at the cost of reduced healing.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you passive burning claws that deal fire damage on hit.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Bone Claws ability.
  • This power is loosely based off of Laura Kinney, a.k.a X-23.

docs.title: Logan
docs.text:
The "Bone Claws - Logan" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance. This variant has 3 outer hand claws.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 30
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 1 Heart / second (0.5 / second with Adamantium Skeleton Infusion)
  • Armor Rating: 8
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 14 (19 with Adamantium Skeleton Infusion)
  • Sprint Speed: 200%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Activate Claws" - Allows you to unsheathe your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Deactivate Claws" - Allows you to retract your claws.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Block - With your claw out, hold your arms up to block incoming damage.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Lunging Attack" - Leap towards your target, dealing damage to anything you come into contact with based on your current damage output + a strength effect 2 modifier.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Feral Senses" - Gain the ability to highlight entities within a 10 block radius for up to 10 seconds at a time.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Wall Crawling" - After unlocking Adamantium Claws, gain the ability to toggle on / off your wall crawling capabilities while your claws are extended with this ability.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Feral Barrage" - Rapidly swing your claws with feral rage to quickly deal damage equal to your current output + a strength 1 effect modifier to your target.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch, No Adamantium): "Savage Berserk Rage" - Send yourself into a violent rage, increasing the damage of all of your abilities by +6, and increasing your healing to an addition 1 Heart / Second at the cost of being harder to control due to your screen shaking.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch, Adamantium): "Super-Heated Claws" - By unlocking the Adamantium Skeleton Infusion, your final ability allows you to Super-Heat your claws, granting you a +2 damage output while active and passively setting entities on fire when you hit them.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch, Phoenix Force): "Phoenix Force Slash" - By unlocking the Phoenix Force, your final ability becomes a ranged slash which deals 12 damage and can set your target on fire from a distance.

Related Information:

  • This power has passive Night Vision.
  • In addition, it can infuse itself with 12 Adamantium Blocks to gain increased damage , Wall-Crawling and an different final ability at the cost of reduced capabilities in water and healing.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you passive burning claws that deal fire damage on hit.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of the Bone Claws ability.
