docs.title: Organic Diamond
docs.text:
The "Metal Mimicry (Organic Diamond)" is obtained via X-Gene at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 26
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 16
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: 8
  • Sprint Speed: 150%

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Not Transformed): "Diamond Form" - Activate or deactivate your diamond form. Convert your body into organic diamond, gaining strength and armor as well as toughness.
    • (Crouch use for reversing into human form when transformed)
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Transformed): "Block" - Block incoming damage for up to 30 seconds but disabling your ability to attack.
  • Slot 2(Non-Crouch): "Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.

Related Information:

  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power is compatible with custom accessories.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you +2 attack damage and increased height.
  • This power has following passives while in diamond form;
    • Psyhic Attack Immunity
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power is loosely based off of Emma Frost.

docs.title: Organic Steel
docs.text:
The "Metal Mimicry (Organic Steel)" is obtained via the X-Gene item at random chance.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 30
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 24
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 14
  • Sprint Speed: 150% (105% when transformed)

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Not Transformed): "Metal Form" - Activate or deactivate your metal form. Convert your body into organic metal, gaining strength and armor as well as toughness. Having this active grants the Slowness 2 debuff, however.
    • (Crouch use for reversing into human form when transformed)
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch,Transformed): "Block" - Block incoming damage for up to 30 seconds but disabling your ability to attack.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Powerful Strike" - Strike the target in front of you with an attack that scales to your damage output.
    • "Strength-Based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
      • Fastball Special - While holding someone with your Grab ability, Right-Click to throw them with all your strength. This ability will not deal any damage on initial contact, but the target being throw is susceptible to taking fall damage still.

Related Information:

  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
  • This power has the following passives while in metal form;
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power is compatible with custom accessories.
  • Activating Metal Form takes you from 1.875 blocks tall to 2.25 blocks tall.
  • While Metal Form is active, you sink faster and move slower in water.
  • Combining this power with the Phoenix Force grants you +2 attack damage and increased height.
  • Copying it with Mimicry grants a version of Metal Form.
  • This power is based off of Piotr Rasputin, a.k.a Colossus.

docs.title: Radiants
docs.text:
Here you can find a list of the different available Radiants within the addon:

  • Radiant - Black

docs.title: Radiant - Black
docs.text:
The "Radiant - Black" is obtained via discovering a Radiant Black hole rarely in a plains biome. Breaking this block will replace any powers you may have with the Radiant - Black abilities. There is no limit to the amount of these that can spawn per world.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 30
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 22
  • Armor Toughness: 4
  • Base Attack Damage: 14
  • Sprint Speed: 275%
  • Flight Speed: 1.75

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Radiant Suit" - Enabled your transformation into your Radiant Black suit, disable your transformation and enable your Second Form.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Radiant Control Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Radiant Fist" - Infuse your punches with Radiant energy to deal +4 more damage per hit.
    • "Radiant Telekinesis" - Use the power of Radiant to lift any target within 5 blocks of you.
    • "Radiant Gravity Pulse" - Send out a radial burst of gravitational force, pushing or pulling nearby enemies.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Increase Gravity" - Use the power of the Radiant to Increase gravity for entities around you based on their proximity to you. Divides the targets motion by the following amounts / range: 100 / 1-2 | 50 / 2/5 | 20 / 6-8 | 10 / 9-10
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Decrease Gravity" - Decrease all entities around you in a 10x10x10 radius by giving them the levitation effect.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Radiant Energy Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fourth slots are:
    • "Radiant Blast" - Launch a small blast of your Radiant energy at your target that deals 4 damage.
    • "Radiant Beam" - Create a large beam of Radiant energy to fire off at your targets deals 12 damage.
    • "Radiant Explosion" - Focus all of your energy to charge up a large explosion of Radiant energy.
  • Slot 5 (Pre Second Form Unlock): "Existence" - Channel your powers to send yourself to / from Existence
  • Slot 5 (Post Second Form Unlock): "Mini Black Hole" - Create a miniature black whole which is launched at your target for an initial 30 damage, with a high destructive explosion radius after contact. this ability has a 30 second cooldown.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model II Reactor.
  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod
  • Once the ability to travel to Existence has been unlocked, placing then breaking a Wither Rose will someone a Robot which can be fought.
    • This Robot must be defeated via Melee methods to unlock the second form.
    • Once defeated, unlocking the "Second Form" ability from the ability menu will automatically be transported to the exact coordinates in the Overworld you left from.
  • While in your second form lose access to all of your abilities, but gain a constant vibrating appearance and following stats:
    • Strength: 26
    • Armor: 28
    • Toughness: 4
  • This power is based off of Nathan Burnett, a.k.a Radiant Black.

docs.title: Sentry
docs.text:
The "Golden Sentry" is obtained via using Golden Sentry DNA. This can be crafted with crafting x4 Cosmic Particles, Super Soldier Serum, x2 Assorted Chemicals and x2 Silence Armor Trim Template inside a Crafting Table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 32
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 3 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 14
  • Armor Toughness: 6
  • Base Attack Damage: 16
  • Sprint Speed: 130%
  • Flight Speed: 2.5

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Thunder Clap" - Using your strength to clap through the air, sending a shockwave out at your target and dealing Sound damage.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Power Punch" - Using your strength leap towards your target and deliver a powerful attack that scales in damage with your attack damage.
  • Slot 1 (Item in hand / Non-Crouch): "Molecularkinesis" - allows the user to convert any iron or gold tool into another iron or gold tool. It can change ani iron or gold ingot, ore or raw metal into any tool as well. It can also transform a tool back into a single ingot or diamond.
  • Slot 1 (Item in hand / Crouch): "Molecularkinesis - Choose Shape" - allows the user to decide the shape the material they are shaping will take.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Golden Light Teleportation" - Teleport yourself up to 10 blocks in the direction you are looking in a flash of golden light. Any targets within 5 blocks of you will gain blindness for 3 seconds.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Photokinetic Shield" - Use your Photokinetic energy to create a sphere-like construct around you to halt incoming damage for up to 10 seconds.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Photokinetic Beam" - Generate a large amount of condensed Photokinetic energy in your hands to shoot it at your target for 12 damage, setting them on fire, but not smelting blocks.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Photokinetic Flash Strike" - Explode a massive build up of energy to everything block of your target to devastate them with an immense amount of energy dealing 30 damage to everything within a 5 block radius around you. This ability has a 1 minute cooldown.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers or any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor once the ability named, "The Void" is purchased.
  • This power has the following passives;
    • Night Vision
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod.
  • This power is loosely based off of, Robert Reynolds, a.k.a Sentry.

docs.title: Void
docs.text:
"The Void" is obtained via purchasing the ability named "The Void" from the Golden Sentry power.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +18
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: +4
  • Armor Toughness: +4
  • Base Attack Damage: +10
  • Sprint Speed: 100%
  • Flight Speed: +0.5

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Infini-Tendril Strike" - Fire off one of your Inifi-Tendrils to repeatedly strike those in front of you for 6 damage per tick with a cooldown of 3 seconds.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Ultimate Intangibility" - Alter your molecular density to phase through solid objects and entities for 5 seconds, inflicting 4 damage per tick to targets you pass through.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Umbrakinetic Voided Shadows" - Cover the area around you in a 10x10x10 radius with shadows, causing Nasuea and Blindness to those trapped in the darkness for 10 seconds.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Umbrakinetic Dark Sun" - Charge up Void energy in your main hand for 3 seconds, then when you release it, cause a strong energy explosion to harm anything in a 5x5x5 radius for 30 damage. This ability has a heavy cooldown.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Voided Umbrakinetic Dark World" - Charge Void energy for 15 seconds and become immobilized with the weakness effect. Afterwards, gives the Wither II effect to all entities within a 25x25x25 for 30 seconds. This will also cause a large destructive explosion at your location, and has a heavy cooldown of 10 minutes.

Related Information:

  • This is a unique secondary that only Sentry can use.
  • Unlocking this power restricts the use any Secondary Powers or Arc Reactors.
  • This upgrade is irreversible without cheats.
  • Unlocking this power will permanently mutate the Photokinetic Beam from the Sentry power to become Red rather than Gold and will increase in damage from 12 to 14.
  • Unlocking this power will permanently mutate the Photokinetic Shield's color.
  • During the nighttime, passively gain an increase of +2 to your strength, +4 to your armor, and +8 to your max health.

docs.title: Speedforce
docs.text:
This page lists the different, obtainable, Speedsters who have a connection to one of the different types of Speedforce. Each can be obtained through a weighted, random chance when being struck by lightning while having the required effect from intaking the assorted chemicals item(Except God of Speed variant).

  • Speedforce (God of Speed)
  • Speedforce (Avatar)
  • Speedforce (Strength)
  • Speedforce (Speed)
  • Negative Speedforce (Avatar)
  • Negative Speedforce (Leech)
  • Tachyon Force

docs.title: Speedforce (Avatar)
docs.text:
The "Speedforce (Avatar)" is obtained via a random chance when using "Assorted Chemicals" and getting struck by lightning.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 44
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 4 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 3
  • Armor Toughness: N/A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3 (8 at max speed)
  • Sprint Speed: 1750%

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Speedforce Enable Speed" - Press to activate your speed. When active, you can hold this button and scroll to increase/decrease your speed. Crouch when enabled to rapidly increase your speed
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Speedforce Disable Speed" - Crouch for turning off your speed.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "High Speed Punches" - Punch as quick as you can at your target, this attack will scale to your damage output.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "High Speed Arm Rotation" - This ability will allow you to rotate your arms rapidly when crouching to either knock targets back or slow your decent. Also this ability will put out flames.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Vibrational Phasing" - When moving at at least 20% vibrate your molecules fast enough to phase through solid objects for up to 10 seconds. This ability has upgrades whic allows you to phase at least 20%/ 10% speed up to 10/20/30 seconds.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Throw Lightning" - By moving at least 20% speed, you are fast enough to throw the lightning that normally trails behind you. This ability does 12 damage and applies shock II for 5 second. This ability is upgradable to usable at 10% speed and then at any speed.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Speedforce Dimensional Travel" - Move fast enough the enter the Speedforce Dimesion to begin absorbing energy. Must be running and at a speed level of 100% or higher to enter, and must stay running to remain there. Running in this dimension for 5 minutes continuously will earn you 1 Speedforce Token.

Related Information:

  • When you have enough tokens you can buy the last ability for transforming this power into the God of Speed Variant.
  • This power can run on water after unlocking the Water Running ability at minimum 30% Speed/ 20% Speed/ 10% Speed.
  • This power can run on up walls or run back down after unlocking the Wall running ability. This ability can toggle on/off at power menu.
  • You can change your Lightning trail with color slider in the power menu.
  • This powers damage output will increase depending on your speed level.

docs.title: Speedforce (God of Speed)
docs.text:
The "Speedster (God of Speed)" is obtained via purchasing the last ability of Speedforce(Avatar) variant.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 44
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 4 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 3
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 3 (23 at max speed)
  • Sprint Speed: 3600%
  • Flight Speed: N/A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Speedforce Enable Speed" - Press to activate your speed. When active, you can hold this button and scroll to increase/decrease your speed. Crouch when enabled to rapidly increase your speed
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Speedforce Disable Speed" - Crouch for turning off your speed.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "High Speed Punches" - Punch as quick as you can at your target, this attack will scale to your damage output.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "High Speed Lightning Punches" - Unlocking this will allow you to utilize your lightning when you strike, extending your range and increasing your damage when crouching.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Vibrational Phasing" - Vibrate your molecules fast enough to phase through solid objects for up to 30 seconds.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Vibrational Phasing" - When moving at least 5% crouch to phase yourself and anyone within 2 blocks of you for up to 15 seconds
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Throw Lightning" - You are passively fast enough to throw the lightning that normally trails behind you. This ability deals 12 damage and applies shock II effect for 5 seconds.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Air Leap" - By moving at least 20% Speed, gain the ability to the move so fast you are able to step on solid air to push yourself off of. When you purchase this, your Lightning Throw will become a crouch ability when moving at 20% or faster.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Slipstream Stasis Field" - By moving at at least 70% of your speed, create a stasis field around yourself using Speedforce energy for 10 seconds, significantly slowing down every entity around you in a 10x10x10 radius.

Related Information:

  • This power can run on water at at least 10% speed.
  • This power can run on up walls or run back down. This ability can toggle on/off at power menu.
  • This powers damage output will increase depending on your speed level.
  • When you activate your Speed you become one with the Speedforce gaining The Speedforce Omnipresence Aura. You can change this aura and Lightning Trail with color slider in the power menu.

docs.title: Negative Speedforce (Leech)
docs.text:

This ability has an upgrade whic allows you to phase at least 20% speed up to 20 seconds and when phasing you will harm anything that you come into contact.

docs.title: Homelander
docs.text:
The “Homelander” is obtained through random chance by using the item "Compound V".

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 20
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: 15
  • Sprint Speed: 225%
  • Flight Speed: 1.38

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-Based Grab" - Use your strength pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Unforgiving Punch" - Using your unrestrained strength, hit your target with a powerful strike. This ability scales with your damage output.
    • "Dashing Strike" - Dash in the direction you are facing to strike your target with a power attack. This ability scales with your damage output.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): “X-Ray Vision” - Using your enhanced eyes, gain the ability to see entities through walls for up to 60 blocks away. Scrolling while the ability is active can allow you to change between being able to see All, Players, Passive and Hostile Entities.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): “Laser Vision” - Unlock the ability to fire laser beams from your eyes. Scroll for changing the output. Output 1 can be used to cook items in furnace but has a lower range, and Output 2 can be used to mine blocks at the cost of lower damage.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): “Toggle Eyes” - Toggle on / off your red laser eyes. Its just for the cool look.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Close Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fourth slots are:
    • "Disorienting Strike" - Hit the target in front of you in vital sensory locations, stunning them and disorienting them for 5 seconds.
    • "Repelling Shockwave" - Rapidly raise your arms with your enhanced strength to repel everything within 5 blocks of you, and damage anything too close with a small shockwave.
    • "Violent Rip" - Grab the target in front of you for 2 seconds, then pull them apart with all your might for a massive attack with a high cooldown.

Related Information:

  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
    • When at 100% flight speed you will launch on the ground with creating an explosion around you and will destroy any blocks that will come in your way while flying. For turning off the destructive flight, you just need to fly at not 100% flight speed.

    • Lava Damage Immunity
    • Explosion Damage Immunity
    • Arrow Immunity
    • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility

    • "Powerhouse Kick" - Kick the target close to you with a strong attack that sends them up into the air
    • "Dash Strike" - Dash in the direction you're looking, delivering a powerful strike that can knock them back on the way. This ability scales with your damage output.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Skull Crushing Headbutt" - Using your strength to Smash your target with your head, dealing damage and disorienting yourself and them, temporarily. This ability scales with your current damage output.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Barrage Blitz" - Attack your target with a flurry of attacks, then move around behind them to continue your attack. You will continue this pattern every few seconds. This ability scales with your damage output.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch) "Viltrumite Ground Slam" - When on the ground, smash the ground at your feet, throwing nearby entities away from you and damaging those that are too close. Purchasing this will place it as the crouch-variant of your "Barrage Blitz" ability.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • The older you are, the longer you can hold your breath when under water / in space (with Ad Astra mod).
  • This power has a weakness to the Sound Poisoning status effect and Scourge Virus.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
    • When at 100% flight speed you will launch on the ground with creating an explosion around you and will destroy any blocks that will come in your way while flying. For turning off the destructive flight, you just need to fly at not 100% flight speed.
  • This power has a forced purple purple tint that will fade as you get older. This texture will gradually fade until (max age) you are back to using your default skin.
  • This power has a unique aging system which will increase in the following intervals:
    • From Days 0-75, age up 3x per Minecraft Day
    • From Days 75-125, age up 2x per Minecraft Day
    • From days 125-300, age up 1x per Minecraft Day
  • Max Age: 300 days
  • This power will gain immunites by getting older
    • Freezing Immunity from age 21
    • Lightning Immunity from age 51
    • Fire Immunity from age 75
    • Explosion Immunity from age 101
      • You will have following passive immunites from start
        • Fall Damage Immunity
        • Arrow Immunity
        • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power gains various stats based on the amount of Minecraft days passed without dying (stats additions below are based on Max Age):
    • Max Damage: + 7.5
    • Max Armor: +7.5
    • Max Health: +12
  • This power is loosely based off of Oliver Grayson,a.k.a Kid Omni-Man.

docs.title: Warrior
docs.text:
The "Viltrumite - Warrior" is obtained via using a Viltrumite (Warrior) DNA. This can crafted with crafting x2 Viltrumite Fossil and a Netherite Smithing Template inside a crafting table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: 40
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: 16
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: 13
  • Sprint Speed: 800%
  • Flight Speed: 1.85

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Combat Abilities" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Strength-based Grab" - With an empty main / offhand, use your strength to pick up an entity and hold them in front of you.
    • "Block" - Block incoming damage for a short while.
    • "Super Air Punch" - Using your strength to punch through the air, with an empty mainhand, creating a powerful impact that can destroy blocks. This ability scales with your strength.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "High Speed Punch Barrage" - Punch as quick as you can at your target. This ability will scale with your damage output + a Strength III modifier.
  • Slot 3 (when in the air): "Super Powered Leaping Punch" - Using your ability to create leverage anywhere, leap towards your target while not on the ground and deliver a powerful strike for heavy damage with a heavy knockback. This attack scales with your max damage output.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Super Ground Punch" - Using your strength to punch the ground below you causing a non-destructive explosion on the ground at your feet. This will knock entities away and deal AOE damage base on how close they are to you.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Explosive Leap" - Crouch, then leap off the ground in the direction you are looking with enough force to explode the ground beneath your feet. This ability will cause a destructive explosion when used.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Swift Arm Swipe" - Swipe your arm through the air to swiftly deal heavy damage that scales with your current output to entities in your immediate path. This ability scales with your damage output.

Related Information:

  • This power cannot use any Secondary Powers.
  • This power cannot use any Arc Reactor higher than the Model I Reactor.
  • The older you are, the longer you can hold your breath when under water / in space (with Ad Astra mod).
  • This power has a weakness to the Sound Poisoning status effect and Scourge Virus.
  • You can decrease / increase your Sprint Speed and Flight Speed with the correct keybinds. Default settings are Down Arrow / Up Arrow. Crouch using will get your percentage to maximum or minimum.
    • When at 100% flight speed you will launch on the ground with creating an explosion around you and will destroy any blocks that will come in your way while flying. For turning off the destructive flight, you just need to fly at not 100% flight speed.
  • Max Age: 700 days
  • This power will gain immunites by getting older
    • Freezing Immunity from age 21
    • Lightning Immunity from age 51
    • Fire Immunity from age 75
    • Explosion Immunity from age 101
      • You will have following passive immunites from start
        • Fall Damage Immunity
        • Arrow Immunity
        • TACZ Bullet Immunity Compatibility
  • This power gains various stats based on the amount of Minecraft days passed without dying (stats additions below are based on Max Age):
    • Max Damage: + 17.5
    • Max Armor: +17.5
    • Max Health: +24
  • This power is loosely based off of Nolan Grayson, a.k.a Omni-Man and generic Viltrumite Officer.

docs.title: Secondary Powers
docs.text:
"Secondary Powers" is a term used to describe powers obtainable that cannot be stacked with each other, but can be used in tandem with most of the Main Powers. Secondary powers can be upgraded via their own Token system.

Tokens are granted at the following Minecraft times:

  • 200 ticks (The time roughly after waking up from a bed)
  • 6000 ticks (Roughly the middle of daytime, and exclusive to the Power Cosmic and the Phoenix Force)
  • 12000 ticks (The time roughly being able to go to sleep)

If using either variant of the Symbiotes, Kaiju, or Scarabs, you will gain +2 tokens at each designated time rather than the standard +1 if transformed.

The secondary powers within the addon currently are :

  • Scarabs
  • Symbiotes
  • Kaiju
  • Phoenix Force
  • Power Cosmic
  • Spirit of Vengance

docs.title: Cosmic
docs.text:
The "Power Cosmic" is obtained via Right-Clicking a Cosmic Silver, an item that has a rare chance of appearing in End City chests.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +8
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 2 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: +10
  • Armor Toughness: +2
  • Base Attack Damage: +8
  • Sprint Speed: +50%
  • Flight Speed: +1.25

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Cosmic Awareness" - Channel the power of the cosmos to sense the life-force of nearby entities up to 30 blocks for 10 seconds with a 30 second cooldown.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Cosmic Telekinesis" - Using your Cosmic Telekinesis to lift an entity within 5 blocks of you and hold them in front of you.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Short Range Teleportation" - Using your connestion to the Cosmic forces, teleport yourself up to 30 blocks in the direction you are looking.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Cosmic Blast" - Channel your Cosmic powers into a powerful blast dealing 10 damage per hit.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Mini Black Hole" - By condensing the Gravity in your hands, fire off a small black hole which deals an initial 15 damage and causes destruction when it makes contact.
  • Slot 4 (Crouch): "Cosmic Dampening" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your fourth slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the fourth slots are:
    • "Cosmic Dampening - Technology EMP" - Channel the power of the cosmos to cause Tech on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to malfunction for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening - Speed" - Channel the power of the cosmos to cause Speed on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to malfunction for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening - Red Sun" - Channel the power of the cosmos to cause Kryptonian DNA on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening - Metaphysical" - Channel the power of the cosmos to cause Cosmic / Magic users you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.
    • "Cosmic Dampening - Genetic" - Channel the power of the cosmos to cause Genetic-based powers on the person you are looking at in a 5 block range to be dampened for 10 seconds.

Related Information:

  • This power can breath in space using the Ad Astra Mod.
  • When you fly with this power you will have a surfing animations.
  • This power forces your skin to silver color.

docs.title: Phoenix Force
docs.text:
The "Phoenix Force" is obtained via a 1% chance after using a Totem of Undying in the End while holding a Phoenix Force Totem in the offhand while having a mutant power active. This Secondary power can only be used by Mutants, and can be stored within a Phoenix Force Totem.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +8
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: +6
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: +4
  • Sprint Speed: +10%
  • Flight Speed: +0.8

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Cosmic Pyrokinesis" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your first slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the first slots are:
    • "Concussive Force Blast" - Fire off the blast of Concussive Force from your hands to push your target back. (Can be upgraded to double the damage but also double the cooldown)
    • "Resurrection Pyrokinesis" - Fire off a beam of your Cosmic Pyrokinesis that channels the Resurrection Force to heal your targets rather than damage them.
    • "Cosmic Pyrokinesis" - Fire off the cosmic power of the Phoenix Force from your hands, setting entities on fire. (Can be upgraded to add two outputs which increase damage and heat at the cost of range and accuracy. At max heat, it will smelt blocks around it on contact and evaporate water.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Cosmic Manipulation" - Open the ability wheel to change what active ability you have for your second slot. Selected abilities are used with non-crouch. The Abilities for the second slots are:
    • "Disintegration Wave" - Fire off a wave of Disintegration Force around you in a 3x3x3 radius using the power of the Phoenix Force, harming all of those who are too close, and knocking them back
    • "Psionic Nexus" - Use your ability as the Nexus of all Psionic powers to dampen any Genetic-based powers within a 10 block radius for 30 seconds. This ability has a very long cooldown
    • "Resurrection Wave" - Surround the area around you in a 5x5x5 radius, healing everything in that range, including yourself, using the power of the Resurrection Force. While active, you cannot move or deal damage.

Related Information:

  • This power has custom glowing eyes and an aura when flying.
    • The aura / wings particles can be toggled via the ability menu.
  • By unlocking the skill named "Phoenix Force - Reborn" you will be able to be brought back to life once per purchase and granted healing when it occurs.
    • This skill cannot be stacked to gain more than 1 extra life at a time, and will need to be repurchased for 12 Phoenix Force Token after each use.
  • If you are not a mutant, this power will automatically be stored in a Phoenix Force Totem.
  • This power grants the following effects to the following mutations (If there is a mutation not listed below, that means it only receives the default stats and abilities):
    • Bone Claws - Glowing claws and deals fire damage on hit
    • Cryokinesis - Stronger Cryokinetic beam
    • Electrokinesis - Passive energy generation
    • Energy Manipulation - Higher overload capacity limit
    • Eyes - Glowing eyes and increased danger sense range
    • Face Change - Increased armor values when face is changed
    • Invisibility - Increased speed while invisible
    • Luck - Grant luck to nearby entities
    • Lupine - Glowing claws and deals fire damage on hit
    • Magnetism - Form iron nuggets
    • Metal Mimicry - Grow in size and strength
    • Optical Blasts - Output control and toggle without needing a visor / helmet / glasses
    • Phasing - Allow for vertical phasing
    • Plasma Energy Conversion - Passive energy generation
    • Pyrokinesis - Passive energy generation
    • Reality Warping - Passive energy generation
    • Regenerative Healing - Faster Healing
    • Self Detonation - Passive energy generation
    • Size Manipulation - Enhanced stats
    • Sonic Sound Manipulation - Enhanced scream strength
    • Speed - Phoenix Force particles in trail
    • Superior Adaptation - When almost dead, gain a quick healing effect (cooldown)
    • Telekinesis - Boosted Telekinetic abilities
    • Telepathy - Boosted Telepathy abilities
    • Weather Manipulation - Faster flight, stronger gust
    • Winged Flight - Reverts techno-organic, gives burning wings

docs.title: Scarabs
docs.text:
The "Scarab" is obtained via first crafting an Unaugmented Scarab Base by using a Scarab Compass from PantheonSent and one Titanium Circuit with 2 Diamond circuits. Once you have the Unaugmented Scarab Base you then can craft a number of colored working scarabs using Dye and Augmented Human D.N.A. Placing your colored Scarab in a crafting grid can revert it back to an Unaugmented Scarab Base to be re-dyed later. You can equip the scarab into your Curios:Back slot.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +8
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: +12
  • Armor Toughness: +2
  • Base Attack Damage: +4
  • Sprint Speed: 150%
  • Flight Speed: 0.75

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch Not Transformed): "Suit Up" - This allows you to enable / disable the Scarab suit.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch While Transformed): "Scarab Tool Selection" - This ability will open a wheel and give you ability to turn your hands into various tools. This tools requires an empty mainhand and offhand to use.
    • "Scarab Blades" - Creates blades out of your arms to deal extra damage.
    • "Scarab Pickaxe" - Creates a pickaxe to be able to mine up to iron level. You can upgrade your pickaxe to be able to mine up to diamond level and tripling the speed.
    • "Scarab Sonic-Blasters" - Creates blasters out of your arms to fire off high frequency sound waves. This ability applies Sound Poisoning.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Scarab Energy Selection" - This ability will open a wheel and give you ability to use your turn your energy to various things:
    • "Scarab Energy Wave" - Create a wave of energy around you which can damage all hit by it within 3x3x3 radius, and cause other technology to malfunction temporarily.
    • "Scarab Energy Shield" - Expand your energy to a translucent shield around you to protect yourself from incoming damage.
    • "Scarab Energy Beams" - Fire of beams of energy from each of your pincers at your target
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Scarab Mode Changer" - This ability will open a wheel and give you ability to transform your scarab to 3 different modes:
    • "Scarab Strength Mode" - Reconfigure your scarab into a Strength form, granting an increase to your strength by +6, armor by +8 and your toughness by +4 at the cost of your speed(Slowness 4). You will not be able to fly, use your 2nd ability bar slot abilities or your blasters while in Strength Mode.
      • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch Strength Mode): "Explosive Leap" - Use your brute strength to leap to high places while creating a explosion behind you.
      • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch Strength Mode): "Grab and Throw" - Grab an entity for up to 5 seconds (full recharge is the same) and launching them in the direction you are looking at.
    • "Scarab Speed Mode" - Reconfigure your scarab into a Speed form and gain speed based abilities. You will not be able to fly or use your 2nd ability bar slot abilities while in Speed Mode.
      • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch Speed Mode): "Enable Speed" - Turn on / off your super speed. This gives +1000% speed.
      • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch Speed Mode): "Speed Punches" - Punch as quick as you can at your target, this attack will scale to your damage output.
    • "Scarab Marine Mode" - Reconfigure your scarab into a Marine form, granting underwater breath, space breathing, and two water based abilities. You will not be able to use your 2nd ability bar slot abilities while in Marine Mode.
      • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch Marine Mode): "Water Absorbtion" - Absorb the water you looking at.
      • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch Marine Mode): "Water Expulsion" - Put out the fire around you.

Related Information:

  • For removing the scarab you need to buy the ability in the middle of the power menu.
  • Changing the color of your scarab will not reset your power progress.
  • This power has Night Vision which will activate under light level 10, when the suit is enabled.
  • When you transform while wearing armor your armor will be stored inside the scarab.
  • After buying the skill you can utilize your bond with the scarab, allowing you to call upon Khaji Da's wisdom and aid. Say "Khaji" in the chat to enable the AI features.
    • Health Display: Your scarab will notify you about information regarding your Health Levels.
    • Adrenaline Based-Healing: Your scarab's passive ability to turn your saturation levels into health when you get too low, as long as the Scarab's AI is active.
    • Highlight Entities: Say "tag" into the chat after enabling your AI to display nearby entities.
    • Scan Target: Say "scan" into the chat after enabling your AI to scan targeted entities current powers.
  • This power has multiple different accessory options to allow for in-depth customization of the user's scarab suit.
    • The different accessories can be customized as Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots.

Following suit customization is for the full combo of suits;

Default Suit:

DCEU SUIT:

GAME SHOW DANGER SUIT:

INFINITE CRISIS SUIT:

LEGADO SUIT:

docs.title: Spirit of Vengance
docs.text:
The "Spirit of Vengance" is obtained via Unholy Pact. Killing villagers in the nether has a 5% chance of dropping a Unholy Pact, typing "I accept" while holding the pact grants the power. Accepting the offer will decrease your Karma by 600.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +8
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: 6
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: 5
  • Sprint Speed: +10% (350% with Hellfire Bike)
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (While not transformed): "Transform" - Transform into the Ghost Rider form and access your abilites.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Hellfire Tools" - While holding the correct tools you can transform them into the Hellfire version. The transformable tools / items are Chain / Sword / Pickaxe / Axe / Hoe / Shovel / Minecart. Hellfire tools naturally function like they have fire aspect and this tools can also cook blocks that are mined.
  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "GET OVER HERE!" - Placing Hellfire Chain in your "curios:hand" you can use this chains while empty-handed to grab entities towards yourself and burn them. If you use chains on blocks it will pull you towards those blocks.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Hellfire Blast" - Channel Hellfire to burn your targets. At output 1, fire it from a single hand and deal 4 damage. At output 2, fire it from both hands and deal 8 damage. At output 3, fire it from your mouth, deal 8 damage and evaporate water / ice blocks when hit. Using this ability at max output will eat away your saturation.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Penance Stare" - Target the sins in your target within 2 blocks to deal damage them, slow them and weaken them. Their Karma rating will directly tie into the damage taken as will the drain of their Karma points. This ability causes you to lose 3 Karma each second when used.

Related Information:

  • After unlocking the Sin Perception ability you will passively gain the ability to have all entities within a 15 block radius of you with negative Karma highlighted, even through walls.
  • Once unlocked The King of Hell you will get a crown which grants you the ability to no longer be killed outside of the Nether. Instead of dying, when your HP is 1 or less, you are immediately sent to the Nether. Additionaly, you will gain a passive healing factor whenever you are in the Nether. You can toggle on / off the crown in the ability menu, toggling of the crown means you dont get the benefit from its abilities.
  • With transforming a minecart you will get a Hellfire Bike and a massive speed increase, you will create a fire trail wherever you go. The Hellfire bike will stack with your speed increases from other sources.
  • When you got the Unholy Pact if you type "i decline" you can destroy the pact and get a little Karma increase.
  • You cant wear any helmets while you are transformed.
  • You have the following passives while in Ghost Rider Form;
    • Fire Damage Immunity
    • Fall Damage Immunity
    • Hunger Damage Immunity
  • The Hellfire tools that created by you will burn other players (who are not Spirit of Vengance users) when they have this tools in their inventory.
  • You will transform automatically at nights until you buy the ability of "Controlled Transformation".

docs.title: Kaiju
docs.text:
Here, you can find a list of all the Kaiiju that are available as secondary powers within the addon. In order to be granted the Kaiju Secondary, you'll need to find and kill one. A kaiju will have a 5% chance to spawn anywhere / anytime a Silverfish spawns.

Kaiju List:

  • No. 8

docs.title: No. 8
docs.text:
The "Kaiju No. 8" is obtained via Killing a Kaiju. A kaiju will have a 5% chance to spawn anywhere / anytime a Silverfish spawns.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +6
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N / A
  • Armor Rating: +16
  • Armor Toughness: N / A
  • Base Attack Damage: +6
  • Sprint Speed: +50%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Transformation" - Change into one of the various forms as they are progressively unlocked.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Change Form" - Change between the Full and Partial Transformations.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Energy Roar" - Roar to release a powerful beam of energy which deals 8 (15 once mastered) damage per hit for a long range at the cost of 3 (then 6) energy per tick.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Energy Boost" - Increase the following stats by the given values at the cost of 2 energy per tick being trained for up to 30 seconds. Attack: +2 | Movement Speed: +0.2
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Berserk Form" - at the cost of 50 energy per second, you can grow in size by +2.0 and gain the following stat changes for up to 30 seconds: Movement: 0.2 | Attack +6 | Armor +6 |

Related Information:

  • The Kaiju operates on an energy system.
    • Being Fully transformed drains more energy than being partially transformed
    • Not being transformed can regain the expended energy.
  • After purchasing the "Kaiju Healing" ability, when your health reaches 2 or less hearts, and you have at least 4 bars of food left, you will be healed and have your foodbar drained.
  • Before unlocking the "Controlled Berserk Form" ability, you will automatically transform into the berserk mode if you take too much damage for 30 seconds.

docs.title: Symbiotes
docs.text:
Within the addon, there are two different Main types of symbiote as seen below. Each type of Symbiote has different abilities. For more information on their differences and how to obtain each one, click on the links to their pages below.

  • Artificial Symbiote
  • Natural Symbiote

Full Symbiote List

docs.title: Artificial
docs.text:
The "Artificial Symbiote" can be created by combining Augmented Human DNA, a Wither Skull, and a Phantom Membrane in a crafting table. Right-clicking this "Artificial Symbiote" will grant a symbiote that doesn't have the full personality of a Natural symbiote, and cannot create a Symbiote Spawn.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +4
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 4 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: +14
  • Armor Toughness: +4
  • Base Attack Damage: +5
  • Sprint Speed: +50%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

in Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Suit up" - activate your symbiote suit to gain the abilities of the symbiote who you are a host of.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Anti-Suit up" - Change into your anti-form, allowing this suit to not retreat when you are on fire, increasing your healing to 1 Heart / 2 seconds, gaining +2 to your attack damage, gaining an immunity to the wither, poison and nausea effects, but losing access to your other symbiote abilities while in this form.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Arm Weapon" - Change your right arm into a weapon which varies in appearance based on the symbiote you are the host of, but will always grant a +6 attack damage when in use. This ability can be used even without being fully transformed. Check each Symbiote's wiki entry for more details on what their weapon looks like.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Symbiote Tendrils" - Have your symbiote explode its tendrils in all directions around you to deal 5 damage in a 2x2x2 radius around you.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Signature Power" - This ability varies based on the symbiote you are a host to. Check each Symbiote's wiki entry for more details.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Grasp" - Plunge your Symbiote's Tendrils into the ground, having them come out and grab any entity in a 5x5x5 radius, dealing 0.5 damage per tick and immobilizing them, but draining your Fury Meter.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiotic Fury" - Revert your symbiote to its most primal form, reverting it to a form of pure power and lack of identity. to gain +9 to your attack damage, but at the cost of rapidly drains your Fury Meter by 10 points per tick.

Related Information:

  • This secondary power has a "Symbiotic Rage" bar on the side of the ability bar which maxes out at 1,000.
    • This bar can be filled by taking any damage while a host of an Artificial symbiote.
  • Only the following Symbiotes can be obtained via the Artificial Symbiote item:
    • Venom
    • Carnage
    • Riot
    • Agony
    • Lasher
    • Phage
    • Toxin
    • Scorn
    • Scream
    • Sleeper

docs.title: Natural
docs.text:
The "Natural Symbiote" is obtained via finding a rare crashed meteor above ground in a Plains biome, and killing the Symbiote that has a 30% chance to spawn from breaking the Mysterious Block in the center.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: +6
  • Maximum Healing / Second: 2 HP / 4 Seconds
  • Armor Rating: +10
  • Armor Toughness: +6
  • Base Attack Damage: +7
  • Sprint Speed: +50%
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Suit up" - Activate your symbiote suit to gain the abilities of the symbiote who you are a host of.
  • Slot 1 (Crouch): "Anti-Suit up" - Change into your anti-form, allowing this suit to not retreat when you are on fire, increasing your healing to 2 HP / 2 Seconds, gaining +2 to your attack damage, gaining an immunity to the wither, poison and nausea effects, but losing access to your other symbiote abilities while in this form.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Arm Weapon" - Change your right arm into a weapon which varies in appearance based on the symbiote you are the host of, but will always grant a +6 attack damage when in use. This ability can be used even without being fully transformed. Check each Symbiote's wiki entry for more details on what their weapon looks like.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Symbiote Tendrils" - Have your symbiote explode its tendrils in all directions around you to deal 5 damage in a 2x2x2 radius around you.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Signature Power" - This ability varies based on the symbiote you are a host to. Check each Symbiote's wiki entry for more details.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Shield" - Increase the mass on your arms to block incoming damage for up to 10 seconds.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Symbiote Spawn" - Ability allows the user create a symbiote spawn to create a new natural symbiote for another player. Killing this Symbiote Spawn will grant the killer a new symbiote. After each use, this ability will need to be re-purchased to be used again.

Related Information:

  • Inner Codex Bond: The codex which develops as you grow your bond with your Symbiote. Foster this connection to unlock further abilities and control over your Symbiote, and their cooperation.

    WARNING: You need to activate the symbiote talk ability by typing your symbiotes name in chat, then typing Mask, Legs or Wall Crawl. If you don't type your symbiote name and send it, the commands wont work. * Symbiotic Bond - Activate: Type the name of your symbiote into the chat to talk with it. You can give commands after activating your symbiote talk. * Symbiote Bond - Mask: After initiating contact with your symbiote, type "Mask" into the chat while your full suit is de-activated for your symbiote to cover only your face and grants you Night Vision. * Symbiote Bond - Legs: After initiating contact with your symbiote, type "Legs" into the chat while your full suit is de-activated for your symbiote to cover only your legs and grants you Enchanced Speed. * Inner Codex - Wall-Crawl: By being bonded while in possession of an Arachnid variant, grant your symbiote the ability to climb walls, permanently. Once unlocked, type "Climb" into the chat with your symbiote listening. * Inned Codex - Symbiotic Bond: Your bond with this symbiote will continue to grow stronger over time. Every day you remain bonded the same Symbiote, you will gain an increase to your stats, when transformed. * The stats gained will remain even if you die, unless you remove your symbiote. * Max Codex Bond Day is 300. * Stat additions below are are based on Max Codex Day: * Damage: +10 * Armor :+10 * The Symbiote Bond Ability allows the Symbiote to protect the host when they are low on health in exchange for some of their food bar. * If the food bar is too low, the ability will not automatically activate. * All Symbiotes are available as Natural Symbiotes.

docs.title: Tertiary Powers
docs.text:
"Tertiary Powers" is a term used to describe powers obtainable via holding a specified item. These power can grant abilities but will not have stat-based abilities to unlock. Depending on the tertiary power, you will need specific Templates to unlock the various abilities in the power.

The tertiary powers within the addon currently are :

  • Hofund
  • Mjolnirs
  • Stormbreaker
  • Neptune's Trident

docs.title: Hofund
docs.text:
"Hofund" is obtained via crafting the sword with x1 Netherite Sword, x2 Uru Templates, and x2 Uru Ingots as shown below:

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: n/a
  • Maximum Healing / Second: n/a
  • Armor Rating: n/a
  • Armor Toughness: n/a
  • Base Attack Damage: +7
  • Jump Height: n/a
  • Sprint Speed: n/a
  • Flight Speed: n/a

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Block Incoming Damage" - Block incoming damage for a short time by positioning your sword.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Spinning Strike" - Spin in a circle while holding the blade of your sword out, dealing damage that scales with your current damage output with a Strength 1 modifier to all entities the sword hits.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Asgardian Strike" - Wind back your Sword, then strike the target directly in front of you dealing damage that scales with your current damage output with a Strength 2 modifier to your target.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Bifrost Beam" - Fire off Bifrost energy from the tip of your sword at your target, dealing 6 damage per hit.

Related Information:

  • This tertiary power uses Uru templates to unlock new abilities.
  • While weilding this sword, you can passively gain minor All-Sight, allowing entities within a 10x10x10 radius to become highlighted

docs.title: Neptune's Trident
docs.text:
"Neptune's Trident" is obtained via crafting the trident with x1 Nth Template, Vanilla Trident and 1x Nth Block inside a smithing table.

Stats:

  • Maximum Health: N/A
  • Maximum Healing / Second: N/A
  • Armor Rating: N/A
  • Armor Toughness: N/A
  • Base Attack Damage: +7
  • Swim Speed: 250%
  • Flight Speed: N/A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Trident Block / Leap" - Guard with your Trident in front of you to block all incoming damages for a short time. Right-Clicking while blocking allows you to leap in the direction you are looking.
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Pressurized Water Stream" - Shoot a steady stream of water from your trident. This ability can be used to dowse flames, campfires and lava. If you are underwater or rain, this ability will do x2.5 damage.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Weather Change" - Change to weather to rain if the sky is clear, or clear if it is raining.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Oceanic Orb of Neptune" - Create an orb of water around you and anyone within a 5x5x5 radius, but you will not be able to move while this ability is active. This ability can only be used by one of the Atlantean variants.

Related Information:

  • This tertiary power uses Nth templates to unlock new abilities.
  • By crouching and left clicking you can throw the Trident. Once thrown, it will summon a lightning strike where it lands. You can turn it off the thrown in the power menu.
  • While wielding the power of Neptune's Trident, you will gain strength.
  • While wielding the Trident, you will be able to swim faster.
  • This Tertiary has special interactions when used by one of the Atlanteans.
    • Strength and Swim Speed gained from the Trident will be higher.
    • You will deal more damage with Water Stream ability.

docs.title: Stormbreaker
docs.text:

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Shoot Lightning" - Using your Lightning energy, fire off electricity at your target. Changing the output can change the damage dealt at the cost of more energy being used, and setting the output to 0 will deal no damage, but instead can charge any / all RF devices worn or in the main/offhand of the target.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Change Lightning Output" - Change the output of lightning to fire off
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Lightning Smash" - Wind back your hammer, then smash it on the ground summoning lightning all around you and causing a large explosion.

Related Information:

  • You do not need to be fast-flying to maintain flight with this hammer.
  • Requires a karma level of 600 to weild
  • Crouching then right clicking will allow you to throw your hammer, but as of version 11.6.1 there is no recall feature

docs.text:

  • x6 Black Tri-Polymer Fabrics
  • x2 Red Tri-Polymer Fabrics
  • x4 Diamond Circuits
  • Batman (Classic) Armor Pieces

in a Tailoring Bench and can be repaired via "Tri-Polymer Fabric Repair Kits".

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 22
  • Armor Toughness: 8

Abilities: When paired with the Batman Beyond Utility Belt thats charged, this suit gains some extra abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Suit Abilities" - This allows you to choose your desired abilities and activate them. Enabled abilities will drain RF from your belt, you can enable all abilities at once or one by one. Abilities this suit have:
    • "Night Vision" - Enable / Disable your night vision.
    • "Wall Climb" - Enable / Disable your wall climb. You can climb walls.
    • "Flight" - Enable / Disable flight boosters which grant you a max flight speed of 0.75.
    • "Glide" - Enable / Disable your wings. You can glide in air with your wings. This glide is similiar to elytra.
    • "Strength" - Enable / Disable your claws. Gain +3 attack damage and you can use your both hands in combat.
    • "Stealth" - Enable / Disable your camouflage. You can turn invisible. This is not true invisiblity your shadow will stay while in this form.

docs.title: Model Dragon Slayer
docs.text:
The Iron Man (Model Dragon Slayer) is crafted in the Tailoring Table with 4 Gold Circuits, 4 Diamond Circuits, a Template III suitset, 4 Red Reinforced Fabric, 6 Yellow Reinforced Fabric, 16 Eyes of Ender, and the Iron Man Model Dragon Slayer blueprint. The armor can be repaired in an anvil with Bleeding Edge Stark Repair Kits.

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 32
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Attack Damage bonus: +2
  • Flight Speed: 1.6
  • Fall Resistance: 51

Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Repulsor Beam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy that deals damage on hit that can be held for 10 seconds before needing to recharge. This armor has an adjustable repulsor damage output up to a max of 4 that can be adjusted by crouching and using the ability key:
    • Output 1 - 5 damage
    • Output 2 - 8 damage
    • Output 3 - 13 damage
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Unibeam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy from your chest reactor that deals damage 18 on hit that can be held down for 5 seconds before needing to recharge.
    • Output 1 - 18 damage
    • Output 2 - 22 damage
    • Output 3 - 26 damage
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Sonic Beam" - Fire off high frequency sound waves and apply Sound Poisoning and Slowness II.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Enable Energy Shield" - Channel repulsor energy through the two ports on your arm, enabling an energy shield that drains energy passively. It can be held for 15 seconds before needing to recharge.Crouching and using the ability key will disable the ability.
  • Slot 5 (Non-Crouch): "Enable Energy Lance" - Channel repulsor energy through your gauntlet, enabling an energy lance that drains energy passively. While active, it will increase your physical damage by 10. Pressing the key again charges up a forward lunge with the lance that deals 20 damage. Crouching and using the ability key will disable the ability.

Related Information

This Suits's recipe becomes unlocked after crafting the Model NIL suit.

docs.title: Mark L
docs.text:
The Iron Man (Mark L) is crafted in the Multiversal Iterator with an Earth-199999 Multiversal Extrapolator and the Model L Endo-Sym Housing Unit. The armor can be repaired automatically by refilling Nanites while transformed or in a smithing table with an Vibranium Smithing Template and an Iron Circuit.

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 28
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Attack Damage bonus: +2
  • Flight Speed: 1.75
  • Fall Resistance: 61

Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Repulsor Beam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy that deals damage on hit that can be held for 10 seconds before needing to recharge. This armor has an adjustable repulsor damage output up to a max of 4 that can be adjusted by crouching and using the ability key:
    • Output 1 - 5 damage
    • Output 2 - 8 damage
    • Output 3 - 13 damage
    • Output 4 - 16 damage
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Unibeam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy from your chest reactor that deals damage 18 on hit that can be held down for 5 seconds before needing to recharge.
  • Slot 3 (Crouch): "Swap Munitions" - Crouching and using the ability key gives you the option to change the type of munition that will be fired:
    • "Kinetic Micro Missile" - Fire a medium range missile that explodes on impact, dealing 3 explosive damage.
    • "Concussive Blast" - fire off a burst of concussive wind which inflicts the target with Sound Poisoning for 4 seconds which applies Slowness II, Nausea II, and 2 sound damage over time.
    • "Taser Launcher" - Fire a single electric charge which inflicts Shock II and EMP, for 5 seconds which deals 2 shock damage over time and disables the target’s technology based powers.
  • Slot 4 (Non-Crouch): "Tool Selection" - crouching and using the ability key gives you the option to transform the weapon on this ability at the cost of Nanites:
    • "Disable Tools" - retract the tools of your armor back into the housing unit.

    • "Hand Cannon" - Form your suit’s gauntlets into a cannon to buff your repulsor damage by 5.

docs.title: Model I - Miles
docs.text:
The Iron Spider (Model I - Miles) is crafted in the Tailoring Table with 2 Gold Circuits, 2 Diamond Circuits, a Template II suitset, 8 Reinforced Black Fabric, 4 Reinforced Red Fabric, 1 Advanced Web Shooter and the Iron Spider Model I - Miles blueprint. The armor can be repaired in an anvil with Stark Repair Kits.

Stats:

  • Armor Rating: 28
  • Armor Toughness: 8
  • Base Attack Damage: +2
  • Flight Speed: N / A

Main Abilities:

  • Slot 1 (Non-Crouch): "Repulsor Beam" - Fire a continuous beam of repulsor energy that deals damage on hit that can be held for 10 seconds before needing to recharge. This armor has an adjustable repulsor damage output up to a max of 4 that can be adjusted by crouching and using the ability key:
    • Output 1 - 5 damage
    • Output 2 - 8 damage
  • Slot 2 (Non-Crouch): "Waldoe Control" - Open up your waldoes to use your waldo related abilities. After enabling them you can use the following abilities in the ability wheel:
    • "Spider Jab" - Use your waldoes to strike your target with a jab attack and deal 12 damage.
    • "Waldoes Guard" - Use your waldoes to cover yourself and block any incoming attack.
    • "Open Waldoes" - Open your waldoes.
    • "Close Waldoes" - Close your waldoes.
  • Slot 3 (Non-Crouch): "Enable Web Mode" - Enable your web mode to do web tricks. Web Swing with Right-Click, and Web Zip with Left-Click.
    • "Web Zip" - Attach a web to a block within 30 blocks in the direction you are looking to be pulled towards it. This ability costs 2 WF when used (even if your target is out of range).
    • "Web Swing" - Shoot a web line to swing between structures.
  • Slot 2 (Crouch): "Change Web-Type" - Switch through all of your available web types in your 4th Slot.
    • "Web Shot" - Fire off a high velocity ball of webs which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit. This ability costs 5 WF and has a cooldown of 1/4 seconds.
    • "Impact Web Blast" - Fire off a larger ball of webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and will trap them in a cobweb. This ability costs 20 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Concussion Web Blast" - Fire off a ball of webs which can deal 1 damage when a target is hit, and hot with a Knockback of 3. This ability costs 15 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Shock Web Blast" - Fire off a ball of webs enhanced by electricity which can deal 2 damage when a target is hit, and applies the Shock effect for 4 seconds on the target that is hit. This ability costs 25 WF and has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
    • "Web Grenade" - Fire off a large ball of condensed webs which can deal 6 damage when a target is hit, and creates a non-destructive explosion when hit. This ability costs 50 WF and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.

Related Information:

  • This Suits's recipe becomes unlocked after crafting the Iron Spider Model I suit.
